episodes.overview: It is too late for the Astrea Familia. Their story ends in tragedy, and this is the tale of how Ryu's life changed forever on that dark day.

episodes.title: Colosseum | Arena
episodes.overview: Their luck couldn't last forever; Bell and Ryu must cross the Colosseum, where monsters constantly respawn. In the end, they may face an impossible choice…

episodes.title: Desperate | Dungeon Do-or-Die Time
episodes.overview: Hope glimmers in the darkness; the Xenos appear in the party's hour of need, and Bell and Ryu make steady progress despite all odds. They may all survive this after all.

episodes.title: White Palace | White Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Bell and Ryu's relationship deepens as the trauma of the Deep Floors pushes them past their limits. They have each other, and that is the only reason they're both still alive.

episodes.title: Welf Crozzo | Shikou
episodes.overview: Bell and Ryu must cast reservations aside in the face of death. Meanwhile, Welf faces a trial by fire he cannot fail; lives are at stake.

episodes.title: Ignis | Flame
episodes.overview: The party narrowly survived, and now they must search for their missing friends. However, they're facing more than just monsters; they're fighting the Dungeon itself.

episodes.title: Daphne Lauros | Friend
episodes.overview: The boss fight extracts a heavy toll on the party, and they must make a choice. If they go one way, they will live. But if they go the other? They will die.

episodes.title: Morgue | Victim
episodes.overview: Critically wounded and trapped within the dungeon's darkened depths, Bell and Ryu's adventure is over. Their fight for survival has now begun.

episodes.title: Amphisbaena | A Song of Despair
episodes.overview: With retreat an impossibility, Bell's party fight for their lives when a Floor Boss spawns early. However, they are all adventurers; they will not die so easily.

episodes.title: Endless | Brutal
episodes.overview: The Juggernaut slaughters its way through a dwindling number of survivors, forcing Ryu to face her demons.

episodes.title: Juggernaut | The Destroyer
episodes.overview: Some monsters you must fight and from others you must flee. But beware the Juggernaut lest you simply cease to be.

episodes.title: Lambton | Ill Omen
episodes.overview: While Bell and Ryu contend with Jura and his insidious abilities, the rest of Bell's allies uncover a barrel of bad apples in the dungeon's dark depths.

episodes.title: Mirabilis | Chaos
episodes.overview: Ryu couldn't be the killer… right? Bell wants to help his friend, but as the body count grows higher, he must ask himself how well he truly knows her.

episodes.title: Cassandra Ilion | Dream Seer
episodes.overview: Ryu, the Gale Wind, stands accused of murder. Bell and his party need answers, but only Cassandra knows that tragedy will befall them if they pursue their friend.

episodes.title: Rabbit's Foot | Rabbit's Foot
episodes.overview: Bell's exploits have earned him fame and a new alias, and Lili worries that means change is coming. Meanwhile, Ryu left a note for her coworkers and vanished soon afterwards.

episodes.title: Argo Vesta | Heroic Slash of Holy Flame
episodes.overview: Haruhime's new ability turns the tide of battle, but the Moss Huge has proven that it knows what it's doing. As the party strategist, Lili has a hard choice to make.

episodes.title: Mermaid | The Girl of Water City
episodes.overview: The party learns too late that the Moss Huge can use other monsters against them. Meanwhile, Bell is alone, but not without allies; the Xenos have not forgotten his kindness.

episodes.title: Parasite | Viscum Album
episodes.overview: The party has two options: either retreat to the surface with the injured or hunt the monster and hope its defeat will dispel the ailment. Both choices carry dire risks.

episodes.title: The Great Falls | The Great Falls
episodes.overview: Bell and his party are making good time and will soon enter the lower floors. But the dungeon crawl is going too smoothly, and Cassandra cannot shake her earlier premonition.

episodes.title: Prelude | Night Before Departure
episodes.overview: Gather your party and venture forth, Bell. The dungeon awaits.

episodes.title: (Argonaut) Return Of The Hero
episodes.overview: The Xenos have fallen into Hermes' trap, and Hermes has asked them to die. After hearing his divine intentions, a group of Xenos centered around Gros go out and act as he intends - running rampant on the surface.Seeing monsters running riot aboveground sends Orario into chaos. Eina works to give directions in the emergency evacuation while a Xenos' claws descend to rend her apart.And on Daedalus Street, a lone monster walks, steadily advancing... to meet the man who haunts his dreams.

episodes.title: (Ultra Soul) Showdown
episodes.overview: With the plan to evade the Loki Familia's tight defenses still in motion, Gareth's enters the battle resulting in Wiene being separated from Fels' group and chased by Tiona... Welf wields his magic swords and his life to stand against Gareth, but the difference in their abilities is clear.Meanwhile, Bell manages to shake Ais off his tail. He meets up with Haruhime, who has rushed out in fear of Wiene's safety, and the two of them search for Wiene together.

episodes.title: (Invisible) Breakthrough
episodes.overview: Bell and the rest of the Hestia Familia have decided to save the Xenos, helping them escape to Knossos and, through that, the dungeon. Making contact with Fels, who is traveling with the Xenos, helps them steadily advance their preparations. Meanwhile, the Loki Familia, and every other adventurer, is moving to stop them. Adding to all this are Eina, Aisha, Ryu, Hermes...and Ais. On this day, everyone carries their own convictions in their hearts, and the spark that will ignite the battle revolving around the Xenos is struck.

episodes.title: (Stigma) Downfall
episodes.overview: Thanks to Asterius joining the battle and Fels' revival magic, Wiene's death was averted and the Xenos narrowly escaped alive. However, Bell obstructed efforts by the subjugation force against the monsters who had emerged on the surface - a fact which will not be erased. Bell faces cruel words and harsh stares throughout all of Orario.Even worse, he receives information that the Xenos who came to the surface were unable to return to the dungeon and remain in hiding...

episodes.title: (Bell Cranel) The Fool
episodes.overview: Tricked by Dix, Wiene heads toward the surface with Bell chasing after her. They are confronted by Ais and the Loki Familia who deem Wiene a threat to Orario...In the face of the city's strongest adventurers, the action Bell chooses to take is... to stand in their way and protect Wiene. To help Bell, Fels, Lyd, Gros, Rei, and the others all make their moves, but "the city's strongest" are an unscalable barrier blocking their way.

episodes.title: (Dix Perdix) A Dream Of Beasts
episodes.overview: Bell and Fels chase after the Xenos and end up entering the man-made labyrinth, Knossos, the base of the Ikelos Familia. There, they watch as Dix's curse causes to the Xenos to unwittingly fight each other... and the madness of a man held prisoner by his cursed blood begins to reach toward Wiene... Meanwhile, on the Eighteenth Floor, the strongest Xenos begins to move, and not even high-level adventurers like Ryu and Aisha, or first-class adventurer Shakti, can stand in the way...

episodes.title: (Knossos) A Man-Made Labyrinth
episodes.overview: The Xenos are on a rampage to avenge Ranieh and the others, driving the town of Rivia on the Eighteenth Floor into destruction. At Ouranos' discretion, Bell has slipped into the suppression force, created with the Ganesha Familia at the core, and happens upon Lyd in the forest on the Eighteenth Floor. After hearing what happened, Bell offers to help in the search for Wiene, but Lyd rejects his offer and leaves. Ryu, who has caught up to Bell, recommends that he return to the surface. Bell makes his choice - to look for Lyd...and Wiene...

episodes.title: (Ikelos Familia) The King Of Calamity
episodes.overview: Wiene has been separated from Bell and the others, left in the care of Lyd and the other Xenos. At the same time, the Xenos have divided into several groups in order to move to a different hidden village. The arachne Ranieh's group accompanies Wiene in the move, but they fall into an evil plot spearheaded by Dix, of the Ikelos Familia. One after another, they are slaughtered, and then the hands of evil reach for Wiene...

episodes.title: (Yearning) A Far-Off Dream
episodes.overview: Monsters who can speak, who defy all that is known. Bell and the others receive a warm welcome from the Xenos. They are so strikingly different from human peoples in form, but they eat, drink, and have fun just as humans do. Seeing this strange sight, Bell and the others can't conceal their confusion. In the midst of the feast, Bell and the others are told by the leader of the Xenos, the lizardman, Lyd, of the Xenos' connection to the Guild, the particulars behind their current situation, and...their intentions...

episodes.title: (Xenos) Heretics
episodes.overview: After her form was exposed in town, causing an uproar, Bell and the others managed to rescue Weine. As they confront the difficulty of sheltering her aboveground, the Guild charges the Hestia Familia with a compulsory mission - to go to the dungeon's Twentieth Floor and take Weine with them. Unable to figure out what the Guild is trying to do, and with no choice but to comply, Bell and the others head back down into the dungeon...

episodes.title: (Monster) A Single Wing
episodes.overview: Weine is a young vouivre, a dragon girl, who can speak and was attacked by monsters in the dungeon. Bell and the others took her with them to the surface and sheltered her in their Home. What is happening in the dungeon? Are there others like Weine? As some answers cannot be found above ground, Bell and the others enlist Aisha and Ryu's help and head back down to the 19th floor where he first met Weine in the Colossal Tree Labyrinth.

episodes.title: (Wiene) A Dragon Girl
episodes.overview: Bell Cranel's rapid growth, his victory in the war games, and the increase in his family members, among other things, has lead to a continuing rise in the visibility of the Hestia Familia in the labyrinth town, Orario. With advances in the dungeon going well, they have arrived on the Nineteenth Floor - the labyrinth of the Great Tree. In the height of battle, Bell is forced to act solo and rescue a girl being attacked by monsters... But this trembling, crying girl is, herself, a monster.

episodes.title: Love Song
episodes.overview: Bell and Hestia spend a relaxing few days at a village in the wilderness, and participate in a local festival. Bell ponders what to do about his relationship with his immortal Goddess, and if he really is ready to love her.

episodes.title: Rakia
episodes.overview: Ares, the God of War, attacks Orario in the name of the Kingdom of Rakia! However, the impulsive god hasn't thought his cunning plan all the way through...

episodes.title: Argonaut
episodes.overview: If it's a war Ishtar wants, then that is precisely what she'll get. Freya is done accommodating the goddess — playtime is over.

episodes.title: Berbera
episodes.overview: A hero does what is right, not what is easy. And as for the consequences? To Hell with them.

episodes.title: Slaystone
episodes.overview: Bell and Mikoto are in grave danger, and only Haruhime can save them. Why is the Renard so important to the Ishtar Familia? The truth is more horrifying than anyone imagined.

episodes.title: Renard
episodes.overview: With the help of Haruhime the Renard, Bell escapes from the Amazoness prostitutes. But he begins to wonder about Haruhime, who says she was forced to be a prostitute against her will and isn't worth being saved.

episodes.title: Ishtar Familia
episodes.overview: Bell is caught up in a new adventure that takes him to the seedy underbelly of Orario: the pleasure quarters.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.overview: The Hestia Familia was victorious in their battle against Apollo, and now they've won a huge mansion and a giant pile of cash! Hestia sets out to recruit for the Familia, but there's something she's forgetting...

episodes.title: War Game
episodes.overview: Five against over a hundred. Those are grim odds for the Hestia Familia. Defeat is nearly certain. Victory, however, would give rise to legends.

episodes.title: Convergence
episodes.overview: Nobody leaves the Soma Familia. Not if they can further Zanis' ambitions. As Lili finds herself in dire straits, Hestia and Apollo negotiate terms for the War Game.

episodes.title: Apollo
episodes.overview: Hestia refuses to play Apollo's manipulative games, but the god is used to getting what he wants and won't take "no" for an answer.

episodes.title: Party
episodes.overview: When a bar fight erupts between Bell's party and the Apollo Familia, the consequences result in a banquet invitation.

episodes.title: The Story of a Familia (Familia Myth)
episodes.overview: A massive floor boss crashes down into the safe zone. Bell and his group of adventurers fight it while Asfi gathers the group up. They find that the escape route has been cut off.

episodes.title: Malice (Show)
episodes.overview: The united parties explore the safe zone of the 18th floor including the adventurers town. Hermes tells Bell he needs to talk to him in private which sets him up to get caught peeking unintentionally at the women in the water pools.

episodes.title: Labyrinth Utopia (Under Resort)
episodes.overview: Bell and his party are tested to the limits while trying to reach the safe zone, meanwhile the Hermes Familia rescue the Takemikazuchi party and follow Bell and his group.

episodes.title: Procession of Monsters (Pass Parade)
episodes.overview: With Hestia waiting, Bell and his party battle monsters on the middle levels of the dungeon. Hermes and Asfi discuss Bell's reputation with his fellow adventures.

episodes.title: Blacksmith (Welf Crozzo)
episodes.overview: Bell's leveling up means that he has acquired a new skill and a title. He also must form a party to explore the dungeons middle levels.

episodes.title: Wanting To Be A Hero (Argonaut)
episodes.overview: Bell's training with  Aiz ends before the Loki Familia goes on a quest. He becomes determined to go on a adventure in the dungeon in order to level up.

episodes.title: Sword Princess (Ais Wallenstein)
episodes.overview: Hestia reluctantly agrees to let a transformed Lili join the expedition even though she is jealous of her. Eina then sets up a meeting with Aiz for Bell.

episodes.title: Reason (Liliruca Arde)
episodes.overview: Eina learns the Soma Familia's true purpose, which increase her suspicions of Lili. Lili goads Bell into venturing into the 10th level of the dungeon.

episodes.title: Magic Book (Grimoire)
episodes.overview: Hestia is overjoyed to be going on what she thinks is a date with Bell, only to have it spoiled. Meanwhile, Lili's motivations are revealed.

episodes.title: The Weak (Supporter)
episodes.overview: Bells special skill allows him to level up quickly, Eina takes him shopping for equipment suitable for him after checking his status.

episodes.title: The Blade of a God (Hestia Knife)
episodes.overview: A creature escapes during the Monster Phillia and Bell and Hestia is ambushed in town. Though things seem hopeless, Bell vows to make a fight of it.

episodes.title: Monster Festival (Monsterphilia)
episodes.overview: Though Bell's patron goddess Hestia is jealous of his infatuation with swordswoman Aiz, she asks the goddess Hephaistos to make Bell a sword.

episodes.title: Adventurer (Bell Cranel)
episodes.overview: Bell goes to deep into a dungeon and finds himself needing to be saved by a higher level adventuress.

title: Blood of Zeus
overview: In a brewing war between the gods of Olympus and the titans, Heron, a commoner living on the outskirts of ancient Greece, becomes mankind's best hope of surviving an evil demon army, when he discovers the secrets of his past.

episodes.title: A Champion's Challenge
episodes.overview: With the fate of the gods at stake, the immortals and the Titans invoke the ways of old and settle their dispute through an epic battle of champions.

episodes.title: Land of the Dead
episodes.overview: Two star-crossed soulmates reunite on the bank of the River Styx. Facing insurmountable odds, the last remaining Olympians square off against Cronos.

episodes.title: The Tower of the Winds
episodes.overview: A humbled Hera pleads for aid on Zeus' behalf. In the home of the wind gods, Heron's search party fights a dark force that pits friend against friend.

episodes.title: The Head of the Maenads
episodes.overview: While seeking an oracle to help guide them on their quest, Heron and his companions intrude upon a mysterious cult and their gruesome blood sacrifice.

episodes.title: Brothers' Journey
episodes.overview: Cronos schemes to weaken Zeus as the Olympians bid farewell to their fallen brethren. Old allies lend their swords in a clash against a colossal foe.

episodes.title: Hellebore
episodes.overview: In the Underworld, the vengeful king of the Titans puts Hades' love to the ultimate test. Seraphim reveals his perilous plan to save Gorgo from torment.

episodes.title: Hades' Choice
episodes.overview: To protect those she holds dear, a selfless immortal confronts a towering terror. Freed from bondage, Cronos vows to teach the gods the meaning of fear.

episodes.title: A Breath Before Dying
episodes.overview: Heron and Seraphim set forth on a mission of mercy while the heavens tremble with the rage of Typhon, who rains destruction down on the gods of Olympus.

episodes.title: The Three Trials
episodes.overview: With the crown of Olympus at stake, the gods clash swords in an epic battle for the Eleusinian Stone and the power it grants to whomever possesses it.

episodes.title: The Hidden Realm
episodes.overview: Aided by an Amazon fleet, Heron, Alexia and Kofi face the giant automaton Talos. To enter the Hidden Realm, Seraphim must first outsmart the Curetes.

episodes.title: Crossing Paths
episodes.overview: Heron and his companions fight a vicious swarm of Keres and encounter a surprising traveler along their journey. Demeter makes a bold play for power.

episodes.title: Judgement Day
episodes.overview: Zeus is sentenced to his fate in the Underworld while Heron visits the land of his birth. Fueled by vengeance, Seraphim unleashes wrath upon an enemy.

episodes.title: Funeral Games
episodes.overview: While mourning their fallen king, the immortals honor Zeus with celebratory games. But the competition between Ares and Heron grows brutally violent.

episodes.title: Winter is Born
episodes.overview: Heron seeks guidance from the smithing god Hephaestus. To win Seraphim's allegiance, Hades tempts him with a promise to bring peace to a lost love.

episodes.title: Weights & Measures
episodes.overview: Seraphim faces harsh judgment in the Underworld and receives an unexpected offer from Hades, who reveals the true origin of the Eleusinian Stone.

episodes.title: A Shadow Emerges
episodes.overview: Hades plots to steal a powerful stone from Zeus's temple while the battle for Olympus rages. Gaia sets Heron on a quest to save a former adversary.

episodes.title: War for Olympus
episodes.overview: Hera resurrects the giants of the sea and assails Olympus, leading to an earth-shattering battle for the ages and the rise of a new demigod: Heron.

episodes.title: The Fields of the Dead
episodes.overview: Seraphim's loyalties are tested when Zeus reveals Hera's deceptions. Alexia's company crosses the Fields of the Dead. War breaks out between the gods.

episodes.title: Back to Olympus
episodes.overview: Zeus brings Heron to Olympus for training, angering the other gods. Alexia embarks on a mission to Melidoni with Heron's companions, Evios and Kofi.

episodes.title: Escape or Die
episodes.overview: Hera directs Seraphim to the powerful sword Zeus once forged for Heron, who is enslaved aboard a galley. Alexia seeks counsel from her mentor, Chiron.

episodes.title: A Monster is Born
episodes.overview: Heron is taken captive by the army of Seraphim, who chases Alexia but instead encounters Hera. The goddess informs the demon leader of his true past.

episodes.title: The Raid
episodes.overview: The goddess Hera discovers the existence of Zeus's bastard son Heron and vows revenge. The polis falls to the forces of the malevolent Seraphim.

episodes.title: Past is Prologue
episodes.overview: After he completes a quest for adamantine ore, Heron learns the truth about his birth from his mother Electra, as well as the identity of his father.

episodes.title: A Call to Arms
episodes.overview: Demons attack the polis near the home of the outcast Heron, who finds allies in the wise elder Elias and the fierce Amazonian warrior Alexia.

title: House of the Dragon
overview: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.

episodes.title: The Treasons at Tumbleton
episodes.overview: Shifting alliances irrevocably reshape the war as Rhaenyra's forces converge around Tumbleton and both sides vie to gain the upper hand.

episodes.title: The Dragon in Winter
episodes.overview: Torn between Mysaria and Daemon's visions for her reign, Rhaenyra grows desperate for a sign that she will prevail.

episodes.title: Faceless Men
episodes.overview: While Rhaenyra and Daemon focus on how best to deal with Ormund, tensions among their neglected allies begin to erupt.

episodes.title: Unbowed and Unbent
episodes.overview: As the search for Aemond and Vhagar continues, Daemon attempts to control the spiraling situation in King's Landing.

episodes.title: Tumbleton
episodes.overview: Ormund's invasion of Tumbleton forces Rhaenyra into a corner.

episodes.title: Rhaenyra Triumphant
episodes.overview: Rhaenyra learns the situation in King's Landing is not what she anticipated. Unable to locate her enemies, and with demands coming from all sides, Rhaenyra must navigate a delicate balance between appeasing her supporters and consolidating her rule.

episodes.title: Queen's Landing
episodes.overview: As Alicent risks everything to fulfill her end of the bargain, Rhaenyra must decide whether the Iron Throne is worth the cost.

episodes.title: Salt and Sea, Fire and Blood
episodes.overview: Driven by her faith in Alicent, Rhaenyra positions herself to take King's Landing while the Triarchy sails to take on Corlys in the Gullet.

episodes.title: The Queen Who Ever Was
episodes.overview: As Aemond becomes more volatile, Larys plots an escape, and Alicent grows more concerned about Helaena's safety. Flush with new power, Rhaenyra looks to press her advantage.

episodes.title: The Red Sowing
episodes.overview: As Rhaenyra looks to gain an advantage by unusual means, Daemon pressures a young liege lord to raise up his bannermen.

episodes.title: Smallfolk
episodes.overview: With few options left, Rhaenyra summons a trusted knight for a risky venture and plots with Mysaria to catalyze the smallfolk. Meanwhile, Daemon's unease grows, and Aemond takes steps to reshape the Green Council.

episodes.title: Regent
episodes.overview: Amid whispers of bad omens, the Greens consider how to fill a void on Aegon's Council, Jacaerys sets out on a rogue mission to strike a deal, and Daemon enlists Lord Willem Blackwood to help persuade the Brackens to bend the knee.

episodes.title: The Red Dragon and the Gold
episodes.overview: In Rhaenyra's absence and with no word from Daemon at Harrenhal, Rhaenys tries to keep the peace on the Black Council as Cole mounts a campaign into the Crownlands. In King's Landing, Aemond continues to undermine Aegon's fragile hold on authority.

episodes.title: The Burning Mill
episodes.overview: As ancient grudges resurface, Rhaenys suggests that Alicent may see reason while the men around her seek bloodshed. Ser Criston proposes a bold scheme. Daemon arrives at Harrenhal to raise an army for the Blacks.

episodes.title: Rhaenyra the Cruel
episodes.overview: As Otto schemes to turn the public against her, Rhaenyra questions Daemon's loyalty. Meanwhile, Ser Criston Cole concocts a misguided plan for revenge.

episodes.title: A Son for a Son
episodes.overview: While Rhaenyra struggles to come to terms with her son's murder, in King's Landing, Alicent grows concerned that Aegon's Small Council may lead them to an all-out war. Larys suggests Aegon needs a new Hand, and Rhaenyra arrives at a fateful decision.

episodes.title: The Black Queen
episodes.overview: While mourning a tragic loss, Rhaenyra tries to hold the realm together, and Daemon prepares for war.

episodes.title: The Green Council
episodes.overview: While Alicent enlists Cole and Aemond to track down Aegon, she plots a heavy political drama in Kings Landing to crown her first-born son. Amidst all the obstacles, the hand, the queen and their allies successfully names Aegon II to be the next king. Otto gathers the great houses of Westeros to affirm their allegiance.

episodes.title: The Lord of the Tides
episodes.overview: Six years later. With the Driftmark succession suddenly critical, Rhaenyra attempts to strike a bargain with Rhaenys.

episodes.title: Driftmark
episodes.overview: As the families gather on Driftmark for a funeral, Viserys calls for an end to infighting and Alicent demands justice.

episodes.title: The Princess and the Queen
episodes.overview: Ten years after the wedding between Rhaenyra Targaryen and Laenor Velaryon, King Viserys survived his collapse and has now fathered 3 children with Alicent Hightower. Rhaenyra navigates Alicent's continued speculation about her parentage of children, while Daemon and Laena weigh an offer in Pentos.

episodes.title: We Light the Way
episodes.overview: Daemon visits his wife in the Vale. Viserys and Rhaenyra broker agreements with the Velaryons. Alicent seeks the truth about the princess.

episodes.title: King of the Narrow Sea
episodes.overview: Rhaenyra continues her search for a suitable match, Daemon returns to Kings Landing and stirs more trouble for the King. Rhaenyra learns a valuable lesson about desires and what it means to be a daughter of a King.

episodes.title: Second of His Name
episodes.overview: Two years later. Daemon and the Sea Snake battle the Crabfeeder. The realm celebrates Aegon's second nameday. Rhaenyra faces the prospect of marriage.

episodes.title: The Rogue Prince
episodes.overview: Six months later. Rhaenyra oversteps at the Small Council. Viserys is urged to secure the succession through marriage. Daemon announces his intentions.

episodes.title: The Heirs of the Dragon
episodes.overview: Viserys hosts a tournament to celebrate the birth of his second child. Rhaenyra welcomes her uncle Daemon back to the Red Keep.

title: The War Between the Land and the Sea
overview: When a fearsome and ancient species emerges from the ocean, dramatically revealing themselves to humanity, an international crisis is triggered. With the entire population at risk, UNIT step into action as the land and sea wage war.

episodes.title: The End of the War
episodes.overview: Barclay stands alone, Salt is lost, UNIT is powerless, and the oceans rise as the war reaches its climax. While traitors conspire, can Barclay find Salt before it's too late?

episodes.title: The Witch of the Waterfall
episodes.overview: Barclay and Salt go on the run in a war-torn London as UNIT reels from disaster. But when Tide threatens the land and Gunsberg advances his plans, the Severance schemes demand blood.

episodes.title: The Deep
episodes.overview: Barclay makes a terrifying descent into the world of Homo Aqua. Back on the land, Kate stands alone as Downing Street conspires with the army to change the course of the war.

episodes.title: Plastic Apocalypse
episodes.overview: Barclay becomes humanity's ambassador when the mysterious Salt emerges from the Tank. But his family's life is torn apart when Salt wreaks revenge upon all mankind.

episodes.title: Homo Aqua
episodes.overview: Barclay's ordinary life becomes a world of terror when an ancient species rises from the sea. As UNIT fights for control, the summit on the Thames reveals terrifying secrets.

title: SPY x FAMILY
overview: A spy, an assassin and a telepath come together to pose as a family, each for their own reasons, while hiding their true identities from each other.

episodes.title: A World Where We Cannot Survive
episodes.overview: The battle in the sewers reaches its conclusion and Loid tries to remedy his relationship with Yor.

episodes.title: Battle to the Death in the Sewers
episodes.overview: The WISE agents and the State Security Service agents clash in the sewers.

episodes.title: Extreme Level 3 Situation
episodes.overview: Twilight and Yuri get an emergency summons from their respective agencies.

episodes.title: Austin's Troubles | A Normal Mixer | Moon Landing
episodes.overview: Mr. Austin is having nightmares after the busjacking incident and Yor goes out with her coworkers.

episodes.title: Take Down the Busjacker
episodes.overview: Henderson gets on the bus to give the children food and water. Billy remembers his purpose in life.

episodes.title: The Red Circus
episodes.overview: A bus carrying Anya's class is busjacked by some terrorists.

episodes.title: White Jealousy | The Eden College Busjacking Incident
episodes.overview: A doctor's jealousy gets Loid into some trouble at the hospital and Anya's class goes on a field trip.

episodes.title: The Mommy-Friends Scheme
episodes.overview: Yor goes out shopping and happens to save someone quite unexpected.

episodes.title: Behind the Scandal | The Path to an Imperial Scholar
episodes.overview: WISE agents protect an opera singer and Henderson gives Anya tips on becoming an Imperial Scholar.

episodes.title: ■■■■'s Memories II
episodes.overview: Loid recalls what happened in the past that led him to where he is today.

episodes.title: Avoid Getting Tonitrus Bolts | ■■■■'s Memories I
episodes.overview: Anya's class must avoid getting Tonitrus Bolts and we get a glimpse into someone's past.

episodes.title: Berlint Panic | The Informant and Nightfall
episodes.overview: The Forgers enjoy a day off while Nightfall hires Franky to help her on a mission.

episodes.title: Part of the Family
episodes.overview: As Bond is on a walk with Loid, he has a premonition of an accident, so he tries to stop it, but is scolded by Loid. He then sees a vision of a building going up in flames and a sobbing girl standing in front of it.

episodes.title: Berlint in Love / Nightfall's Daily Life
episodes.overview: Becky is very excited about a romantic drama on TV, so she heads over to the Forgers' place to see Loid, who she fell in love with instantly after seeing his picture. Becky aggressively pursues Loid.

episodes.title: Enjoy the Resort to the Fullest / Bragging About Vacation
episodes.overview: The morning after the attack from the assassins and the bomb scare, the cruise ship arrives at the resort island. Loid and Anya meet up with Yor and the three enjoy a family vacation!

episodes.title: The Hand That Connects to the Future
episodes.overview: Due to the movements the State Security Service members were making, Loid finds out that there was a bomb on the ship. Loid leaves Anya at the daycare in a hurry then disguises himself as a State Security Service member to take care of the bomb.

episodes.title: The Symphony Upon the Ship / Sis's Herb Tea
episodes.overview: The deck is filled with passengers enjoying the fireworks show. Anya and Loid were also enjoying the fireworks. Meanwhile, Yor's mission finally reaches its climax. She tries to help Olka and the others escape, but they are surrounded by assassins!

episodes.title: Who Is This Mission For?
episodes.overview: Loid tries to pick out souvenirs that will make him look like a fun and happy dad so he can cheer Anya up. Meanwhile, Yor was facing off with Sickle-and-Chain Barnaby.

episodes.title: The Fearsome Luxury Cruise Ship
episodes.overview: After boarding the cruise ship, Yor began her duty as bodyguard to Olka and her son. Meanwhile, Yor's superior, Matthew, finds an assassin who is after Olka and her son.

episodes.title: Plan to Cross the Border
episodes.overview: On a mission as Thorn Princess and using her job as city hall as a cover, Yor is tasked with protecting the only survivors of the Gretcher family, Olka and her son, and helping them escape to a different country by traveling on a cruise ship.

episodes.title: The Pastry of Knowledge / The Informant's Great Romance Plan II
episodes.overview: Eden's legendary dessert finally appears! In order to obtain the macaroons that supposedly can make you into an Imperial Scholar if eaten, Anya and her friends race to get to them first.

episodes.title: Mission and Family / The Elegant Bondman / The Heart of a Child/Waking Up
episodes.overview: Yuri is doing great at his job with the Secret Police. His assignment today is to investigate a former newspaper reporter suspected of selling articles slandering Ostania to Westalis. Anya's favorite cartoon hero Bondman shows off his elegant spy moves!!

episodes.title: Bond's Strategy to Stay Alive / Damian's Field Research Trip
episodes.overview: Bond sees an ominous future and believes that it's Yor's food that's going to cause it. In order to change this fate, Bond leaves the house to search for Loid! Henderson orders Damian, Emil, and Ewen to go on a field research trip with Mr. Green.

episodes.title: Follow Papa and Mama
episodes.overview: Yor is shot in the butt while on a mission and looks miserable when she gets home. Loid mistakes her very apparent miserable mood as her being unhappy with their marriage of convenience and offers to take her out on a date.

episodes.title: First Contact
episodes.overview: The day of the semi-annual get-together for Imperial Scholars has come and Loid tries contact with Donovan Desmond through Damian. But Damian is not sure whether his father even wants to meet him.

episodes.title: The Role of a Mother and Wife / Shopping With Friends
episodes.overview: Loid realizes that Yor is burdened by the matter concerning Fiona and decides to take her out. But when he wants to talk to her about the issue, only more misunderstandings arise. Later, Becky rents out a whole store and starts her own little fashion show with Anya.

episodes.title: The Unwavering Path
episodes.overview: The tennis match continues and the opponents resort to all sorts of other nasty tricks to win against Loid and Fiona. To make matters worse, another obstacle gets in their way right after the match.

episodes.title: The Underground Tennis Tournament: The Campbelldon
episodes.overview: Loid and Fiona play in an underground tennis tournament in order to get their hands on a painting that contains a secret message. But they soon realize that there is something fishy going on in these matches.

episodes.title: Nightfall / First Fit of Jealousy
episodes.overview: Agent Nightfall is out to take Yor's role as Loid's wife. She visits the Forgers' home when Loid and Anya are away and tries everything to drive Yor away.

episodes.title: Investigate the General Hospital / Decipher the Perplexing Code
episodes.overview: Anya needs to write a report about a profession that interests her, so she joins Loid at the Berlint General Hospital. Later, Anya becomes interested in deciphering codes and writes secret messages for Loid and the others.

episodes.title: A Revenge Plot Against Desmond / Mama Becomes the Wind
episodes.overview: A boy Anya has never noticed at school shows up and wants to take revenge on Damian as he has to leave school because of the Desmonds. Later, Yor has to deliver Anya's forgotten gym clothes!

episodes.title: Uncle the Private Tutor / Daybreak
episodes.overview: The midterms are coming up and Loid is worried about Anya's results. Yor calls Yuri, who is supposed to tutor Anya. After the exams, Loid wants to help in his own way, but in the process he meets an unexpected adversary.

episodes.title: Carry Out the Griffin Plan / Fullmetal Lady / Omelet Rice♡
episodes.overview: Anya tries to win Damian's favor again and offers to help him with a project in art class. But unfortunately, her artistic skills leave much to be desired.

episodes.title: Yor's Kitchen / The Informant's Great Romance Plan
episodes.overview: Yor takes cooking lessons from Camilla and Loid has to help Franky with his date.

episodes.title: A New Family Member
episodes.overview: Anya insists that the family takes in the dog. But when she goes to school the next day, she realizes that something very important is missing: a name. But how do you come up with a name for a dog?

episodes.title: Disarm the Time Bomb
episodes.overview: Anya sees a vision through the dog's mind that an explosion at the clock tower will kill Loid. Unable to tell Yor about this without revealing her ability, she sets out to defuse the bomb herself.

episodes.title: Project Apple
episodes.overview: As a reward for her first Stella Star Anya wants a dog and she spots one that catches her interest. Secretly she sneaks after him and unintentionally ends up in the secret hideout of a terrorist group.

episodes.title: Penguin Park
episodes.overview: Loid is burdened with one mission after another from WISE and comes home exhausted. He then hears neighbors gossiping that he's neglecting his family. Because he can't let anyone doubt them as a family for the sake of Operation Strix, he decides to take his family to the aquarium the next day they have off to show everyone that they get along. However, he is assigned another mission from WISE while he's there, and...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Stella
episodes.overview: In order for parents to attend one of the social gatherings at Eden College, their children need to be Imperial Scholars, but Anya hating to study makes this rather difficult. Loid then comes up with a plan to get Anya to get Stella Stars by doing community service rather than with her academics. But when she ends up volunteering at a hospital, she continuously messes up. Later, she hears a child drowning in a pool with her telepathy and...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: The Great Dodgeball Plan
episodes.overview: A rumor spreads amongst the first graders at Eden College saying that if they do well in their next PE class, they will get rewarded with Stella Stars. Anya is determined to get a Stella Star, so she trains with Yor. Thus begins the dodgeball match between Cecile Hall and Wald Hall! Anya and her classmates are determined to win, but they are faced with the giant, Bill Watkins.Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Show Off How In Love You Are
episodes.overview: In order to prove to Yuri that they are actually a married couple, Loid and Yor are supposed to kiss. Loid is willing to get this done immediately for the sake of Operation Strix, but Yor can't do this sober, so she ends up downing a bunch of wine and gets drunk.  Yuri sees his sister this way, also gets drunk, and is unable to make rational decisions anymore...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: The Counter-Secret Police Cover Operation
episodes.overview: Ostania's counterintelligence agency and national security bureau conducts spy hunts and keeps surveillance on its citizens to maintain peace within the country. They are also called the Secret Police and are feared. Yor's younger brother Yuri actually belongs to the Secret Police and is hunting down spies while keeping this a secret from Yor and others around him. One day, he suddenly shows up at the Forger residence. The Forgers, who are full of secrets, and Yuri, who has a secret identity, come face to face!Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: The Target's Second Son
episodes.overview: Anya ends up with a Tonitrus Bolt after she hit Damian Desmond. Sadly, this causes her to stand out for the wrong reasons in class which depresses her, but she ends up friends with Becky, and school becomes a little more fun. She also tries to apologize to Damian for hitting him, but just can't seem to get the words out. For the sake of Operation Strix, Loid disguises himself as someone who works at the school and tries to help Anya reconcile from the shadows, but...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: The Friendship Scheme
episodes.overview: Anya's uniform is finished. Loid has to go to a WISE strategy meeting, so he has Yor pick up the uniform as he heads to the safehouse. At the meeting, he finds out that Anya will have to receive 8 Stellar Stars and become an Imperial Scholar at Eden College in order for him to successfully complete Operation Strix. Meanwhile, Anya is very excited about getting her new uniform. But there are always criminals on the lookout for wealthy students from Eden College and Anya gets targeted by a group of hoodlums.Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Will They Pass Or Fail?
episodes.overview: The day that Eden College would announce the applicants that successfully got into the school had finally arrived, but Anya's number is not listed. The Forgers fall into the depths of despair but are greeted by Henderson. He praises them for their interview and tells them that Anya is at the top of the waiting list. Three days later, they find out that Anya got into the school! Franky comes over to celebrate with the Forgers and they all agree to reward Anya for working so hard. What Anya asks for...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: The Prestigious School's Interview
episodes.overview: The day they had been preparing for has finally arrived! The Forgers are fully prepared and head to the interview. As soon as they enter the school grounds, Loid feels someone watching them. All of the applicants were being observed from the shadows by the instructors of the academy. The exam had already begun. Housemaster Henderson, who would be grading their performance, kept a keen eye on how the Forgers were acting and seeing if they were truly worthy of the prestigious Eden College.Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Prepare for the Interview
episodes.overview: Yor moves in with Loid and Anya. Now that they are a family, they need to prepare for the interview. But Loid realizes with how Anya and Yor currently are, the interview probably won't go well. In order to make sure they all understand how an upper-class family should be, Loid decides that they should all go out as a family. They go to the theatre and a museum, but it's just not clicking with Anya and Yor. Twilight begins to lose hope, but...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Secure a Wife
episodes.overview: Civil servant Yor Briar has a secret identity: an assassin named the Thorn Princess. Lately, single women had been suspected of being spies, which was making Yor nervous. Meanwhile, Loid was searching for someone to play Anya's mother so they could attend the interview at Eden College. He just happens to run into Yor at a boutique. Anya reads Yor's mind and finds out that she's an assassin and tries to get Loid to ask Yor to play her mother.Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Operation Strix
episodes.overview: Twilight is an agent that works for WISE, Westalis's intelligence agency, and he is tasked with investigating Desmond, who is in Ostania and planning to start a war. Twilight disguises himself as the psychiatrist Loid Forger and adopts a girl named Anya so that he can enroll her into the prestigious Eden College to get closer to his target. Unbeknownst to him, Anya is actually a telepath who can read people's minds. One day, members of a mafia group that is after Twilight kidnaps Anya. Loid realizes that he needs to reconsider his priorities and...Source: crunchyroll

title: Daredevil: Born Again
overview: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.

episodes.title: The Southern Cross
episodes.overview: The city and its heroes enter an unprecedented era.

episodes.title: The Hateful Darkness
episodes.overview: A trial close to Matt Murdock's heart grabs the city's attention.

episodes.title: Requiem
episodes.overview: Fisk's operation is dealt an irrevocable blow. The resistance spills over into the streets.

episodes.title: The Grand Design
episodes.overview: The Anti-Vigilante Task Force intensifies its search for Daredevil and Bullseye.

episodes.title: Gloves Off
episodes.overview: Bullseye adopts a new morning routine. Fisk takes the ring.

episodes.title: The Scales & the Sword
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock and Karen Page find new allies.

episodes.title: Shoot the Moon
episodes.overview: Fisk tries a new tactic to lure Daredevil out of hiding.

episodes.title: The Northern Star
episodes.overview: Daredevil is in hiding, but he isn't laying low. A shadowy player from Washington, D.C. emerges.

episodes.title: Straight to Hell
episodes.overview: Mayor Fisk becomes Mayor Kingpin, and Daredevil is unleashed as chaos takes over the city.

episodes.title: Isle of Joy
episodes.overview: At his inaugural Black and White Ball, Mayor Fisk tightens his grip on New York City. Matt Murdock learns shocking information when an old enemy reaches out.

episodes.title: Art for Art’s Sake
episodes.overview: Daredevil. Is. Back. It's a race to stop Muse before he can kill again. Fisk's rivals in the criminal underworld take advantage of the chaos.

episodes.title: Excessive Force
episodes.overview: When a serial killer terrorizes the streets of New York, the city needs a savior.

episodes.title: With Interest
episodes.overview: A day in the life of Matt Murdock gets unexpectedly intense, forcing him to team up with a familiar face.

episodes.title: Sic Semper Systema
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock and Wilson Fisk's darker halves fight to be unleashed.

episodes.title: The Hollow of His Hand
episodes.overview: The trial of Hector Ayala begins. Fisk's old business associates seek to claim his vacant mantle.

episodes.title: Optics
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock gets a new client who's more than he claims to be. Fisk learns the power of optics.

episodes.title: Heaven’s Half Hour
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock gives up the mask. Wilson Fisk has his sights set to new heights.

title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
overview: Natsuki Subaru, an ordinary high school  student, is on his way home from the convenience store when he finds  himself transported to another world. As he's lost and confused in a new  world where he doesn't even know left from right, the only person to  reach out to him was a beautiful girl with silver hair. Determined to  repay her somehow for saving him from his own despair, Subaru agrees to  help the girl find something she's looking for.

episodes.title: A Single-Minded Star
episodes.overview: Subaru searches for a way to deal with Reid, Gluttony, mabeasts, and a giant scorpion attacking the tower.

episodes.title: Five Obstacles
episodes.overview: Subaru returns from the corridor of memories to find the tower under attack by mabeasts.

episodes.title: Stand Up
episodes.overview: Subaru decides to read Reid's book of the dead in hopes of finding a way to defeat him.

episodes.title: From Now On
episodes.overview: After waking up without his memories yet again, Subaru makes up his mind to save Meili this time.

episodes.title: Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World
Who Are You?
episodes.overview: Subaru and his crew brave the Auguria Dunes in search of a "wise man" in hopes of saving their friends.

episodes.title: Walking Out of a Convenience Store, and Into a Mysterious World
episodes.overview: Julius overhears Anastasia and Subaru talking about Anastasia's current condition.

episodes.title: Julius Juukulius
episodes.overview: Subaru and crew attempt to get past the second floor of the tower, but its examiner poses a tough challenge.

episodes.title: Stick Swinger
episodes.overview: The Great Pleiades Library doesn't seem to have the answers Subaru seeks, so he decides they must go further.

episodes.title: A White Sky Asterism
episodes.overview: Subaru and company meet Shaula, keeper of the Pleiades Watchtower, who leads them to the first of its trials.

episodes.title: The Keeper of the Watchtower
episodes.overview: The party is separated just before reaching the Pleiades Watchtower. Subaru awakens to find he's underground.

episodes.title: Overcome Sand Time
episodes.overview: Subaru and company struggle to cross the Auguria Dunes on the way to the Pleiades Watchtower.

episodes.title: The Reason I'm Taking You With Me / Gorgeous Tiger Reloaded
episodes.overview: Subaru sets out for the Pleiades Watchtower in hopes of saving his friends and the people of Priestella.

episodes.title: The Result of the Battle for Priestella
episodes.overview: Otto and Beatrice battle Gluttony, the last of the Sin Archbishops terrorizing Priestella.

episodes.title: A Hideous Dinner Party
episodes.overview: While battling Lye Batenkaitos, Otto discovers the secret to the Sin Archbishop's power.

episodes.title: Theresia van Astrea
episodes.overview: Wilhelm finds himself face to face with his beloved wife who died years ago.

episodes.title: The Warrior's Commendation
episodes.overview: Capella uses Al's admiration for Priscilla against him, and Garfiel fights the legendary "Eight-Arms" Kurgan.

episodes.title: Regulus Corneas
episodes.overview: Emilia seeks the aid of Regulus's wives in dethroning the little king once and for all.

episodes.title: Liliana Masquerade
episodes.overview: Liliana gives the performance of her lifetime to help Priscilla defeat the Sin Archbishop of Lust.

episodes.title: The Plan to Conquer Greed
episodes.overview: Subaru thinks long and hard about how Regulus's Authority should work...

episodes.title: City Scramble
episodes.overview: While the others deal with the other Archbishops, Subaru puts his plan to stop Regulus into action.

episodes.title: The One I'll Love Someday
episodes.overview: Subaru and the others hold a meeting in the city hall to develop a strategy against the four Sin Archbishops. However, Emilia is slowly running out of time...

episodes.title: The Newest of Heroes and the Most Ancient of Heroes
episodes.overview: Through a Witch's Cultist's conference mirror, Emilia tells Al where the Sin Archbishops are and asks him to protect Beatrice. Al relays Emilia's message to Subaru, and the gang begins to devise a strategy to win back the control towers.

episodes.title: Conditions of the Knight
episodes.overview: Bishop Regulus of the Seven Deadly Sins wants to force Emilia to marry him, even though he already has hundreds of wives. While he is having the wedding hall prepared, Subaru and the others are planning to rescue Emilia and reclaim the city...

episodes.title: A Dark Torrent
episodes.overview: The attack on the city hall enters its second phase. Subaru and Crusch breach the interior, but there they are awaited by Capella, who has some sneaky tricks up her sleeve...

episodes.title: Operation: Take Back the Government Office
episodes.overview: Subaru and his comrades find themselves in a dire situation after the city was taken over by the Sin Archbishops. Now, they are devising a plan to first reclaim the city hall...

episodes.title: Gorgeous Tiger
episodes.overview: After the incident in the main square, Priestella has fallen into chaos and Emilia has been kidnapped. Now it's up to Subaru and the others to rescue Emilia and the city.

episodes.title: A Showdown of Fire and Ice
episodes.overview: Subaru desperately tries to fend off the attack from Sin Archbishop Sirius. But then, other Archbishops appear...

episodes.title: Theatrical Malice
episodes.overview: A year has passed since the battle at the Sanctuary, and Subaru has been spending fulfilling days united with Emilia's camp. However, his peaceful everyday life ends with the arrival of a single letter.

episodes.title: Under the Moon, A Crazy Step
episodes.overview: It comes to the final confrontation between Subaru, Emilia, Beatrice and one of the three great magic monsters, the Great Rabbit. Can they defeat the monsters and finally put an end to Roswaal's plan?

episodes.title: Choose Me
episodes.overview: Emilia has survived the trial, but suddenly another disaster happens. Meanwhile, Subaru is still trying to rescue the reluctant Beatrice from the burning residence.

episodes.title: Love Me Down to My Blood and Guts
episodes.overview: While Garfiel fights Elsa in the residence, Ram and Puck face Roswaal. Can they overcome these superior opponents?

episodes.title: Happiness Reflected on the Water's Surface
episodes.overview: Garfiel, Frederica, Subaru and Otto desperately fight for survival in the residence. Meanwhile, Emilia faces the second trial.

episodes.title: Reunion of Roars
episodes.overview: After the confrontation with Roswaal, Subaru leaves for the residence together with Otto and Garfiel. But what secret plan has Otto made up with Ram?

episodes.title: The Beginning of the Sanctuary and the Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: The whole truth about the creation of the sanctuary comes to light. Armed with this information, Subaru tries to persuade Roswaal to give in. But Roswaal does not seem to want to give up so easily.

episodes.title: The Permafrost of Elior Forest
episodes.overview: In the trial, Emilia finally learns what led to the loss of her memories and to her sleeping in the ice for a long time. Meanwhile, Subaru turns to Roswaal with a new proposal.

episodes.title: The Day Betelgeuse Laughed
episodes.overview: While Shima tells the others about the memories of the original Lewes, Emilia learns more about what happened in her childhood.

episodes.title: A Journey Through Memories
episodes.overview: Emilia, together with the witch Echidna, confronts her lost memories again in the trial. This time she is determined to persevere to the end. But some surprising characters appear in her memories.

episodes.title: Nobody Can Lift a Quain Stone Alone
episodes.overview: It comes to a showdown between Subaru and Garfiel. Can he defeat the incredibly strong half-man and bring him back to his senses?

episodes.title: Otto Suwen / A Reason to Believe
episodes.overview: Otto tries to stop Garfiel alone to buy Subaru more time to talk to Emilia. But Garfiel is not an opponent you can face alone so easily.

episodes.title: STRAIGHT BET
episodes.overview: After being convinced by Otto that he should rely on his friends, Subaru makes a risky bet with Roswaal that could be the key to saving the sanctuary and the residence.

episodes.title: The Sounds That Make You Want to Cry
episodes.overview: Satela, the Witch of Envy, has appeared in the dream world of Echidna. Confronted with all seven witches at once, Subaru must undergo a cruel experience. Will his determination to save the others stand unbroken?

episodes.title: The Witches' Tea Party
episodes.overview: Subaru sees visions from a present he cannot have experienced. Then the Witch of Greed Echidna reveals her true intentions to him. Will Subaru accept her offer?

episodes.title: The Taste of Death
episodes.overview: Subaru is back at the residence to fight off the attack this time together with Beatrice. But more enemies show up than originally expected.

episodes.title: I Know Hell
episodes.overview: Surrounded by the shadow of the Witch of Envy, Garfiel and Subaru go on the attack. The witch intends to go to the residence of Roswaal and Subaru must prevent this at all costs.

episodes.title: Love Love Love Love Love Love You
episodes.overview: After Subaru finally finds someone in Echidna to whom he can tell the truth about his respawning, he finds out what it is about the rabbits that ate him. Echidna gives him the chance to talk to the witch who created the white whale as well as the rabbits.

episodes.title: The Value of Life
episodes.overview: Subaru has been rescued from Garfiel's captivity by Otto. But before he escapes from the sanctuary, he has something to discuss with Roswaal.

episodes.title: Friend
episodes.overview: Subaru has been saved by Beatrice at the last moment, against his wishes. But in conversation with her, it becomes apparent that she has a unknown motive.

episodes.title: The Maiden's Gospel
episodes.overview: Subaru wakes up again at the cemetery right after Emilia's test. He decides to return to the residence earlier than the last time. What will he find there? Does Frederica have anything to do with what happened there?

episodes.title: A Step Forward
episodes.overview: The exam has been nasty for Emilia, while Subaru has passed it. But then Lord Roswaal invites him to a secret conversation.

episodes.title: Parent and Child
episodes.overview: Subaru wakes up in his bed in his parents' house. Here he must confront his past alongside his father and mother. What's it all about and how is Emilia, who has taken the test at the sanctuary?

episodes.title: The Long-Awaited Reunion
episodes.overview: After Subaru encounters the Witch of Greed, he, Emilia and Otto finally reach the sanctuary. But the situation there is quite different than expected.

episodes.title: The Next Location
episodes.overview: When Subaru and the others return to the village, they find both village and Roswaal residence abandoned. Subaru looks for answers from Beatrice, who seems to know more than she wants to reveal.

episodes.title: Each One's Promise
episodes.overview: Petelgeuse and the white whale are defeated. But suddenly all memory of Rem disappears after she is attacked by two new bishops of the Witch Cult. Once again, Subaru is faced with the difficult decision of having to repeat everything in order to save Rem.

episodes.title: That's All This Story Is About
episodes.overview: Emilia is hurriedly ushered to the capital along with the villagers under the orders of a mysterious benefactor while escorted by a rag-tag group of individuals from various and opposing factions. She has but one question on her mind: who could this man be and why would he go so far? Meanwhile, Subaru and Julius face off against the Archbishop of Sin Betelgeuse for the ultimate time. Unfortunately, he is very persistent even beyond death, belying his nature of Sloth. Subaru is relentlessly chased while he catches up to Emilia to save her one last time and answer her question.

episodes.title: The Self-Proclaimed Knight and the Greatest Knight
episodes.overview: Subaru devises a new plan to correct the mistake of the blank letter sent to the manor, encourage the evacuation of the villagers and move Emilia away from her current location. With these preparations complete, he enacts the second part of his plan designed to cut off the Fingers before severing the Unseen Hand once and for all.

episodes.title: Nefarious Sloth
episodes.overview: The group is making its way in the Mathers domain when suddenly everyone but Subaru disappears and a strange, suffocating atmosphere seeps through the forest. He quickly figures out it is nothing but an illusion, and with help from Julius on the other side, dispels the barrier for everyone caught in it. However, arriving at the village doesn't make convincing the residents to evacuate easy. Time is running out, and the invisible hand of sloth makes its presence at the back of Subaru's mind more and more nefarious.

episodes.title: Flash of Sloth
episodes.overview: With the battle against the White Whale now over, the mercenary force setting up the blockade of the road comes back, Julius at the lead. His arrival gives rise to mixed feelings for Subaru, but after Julius sincerely thanks him for ridding the world of the monster, Subaru finds it in himself to apologize for his past behavior. The group now looks forward, ready to enter the Mathers domain...

episodes.title: A Bet That Fights Against Despair
episodes.overview: Subaru and Rem are at a loss for words. The battle against the White Whale, which seemed to be going in their favor through attrition, suddenly took on completely different proportions. With their tactical superiority and advantage quickly dwindling, the combined forces all but get tangled up in the threads of despair. That's when Subaru decides to yell out his next move...

episodes.title: Wilhelm van Astrea
episodes.overview: Subaru has devoted everything he had, and done all he could do. His passion has captured Crusch's heart, as well as Anastasia's cooperation, and they all enter into the battle against the White Whale together.

episodes.title: Battle Against the White Whale
episodes.overview: To save Emilia, Subaru approaches Crusch to negotiate the formation of an alliance. His terms are a bit difficult for Crusch to believe, but she can see that Subaru isn't lying.

episodes.title: From Zero
episodes.overview: Subaru laments that he could not do anything or save anyone, and has no options left. Exhausted, he suddenly takes off running at full speed as if he's made a decision...

episodes.title: Disgrace in the Extreme
episodes.overview: A mysterious figure appears before Subaru and his traveling companions. As the looming beast attacks with a deafening bellow amidst the darkness and fog, Rem determines that it will be too difficult to escape...

episodes.title: The Greed of a Pig
episodes.overview: Subaru wakes up in front of the appa shop once again. Feeling boxed in on all sides due to his own lack of power to change the situation, he seeks the help of others. First, he seeks the help of Crush, who flatly declines any further involvement passed her contractual obligation of healing Subaru. His requests to Anastasia and Priscilla similarly go unanswered despite his pleas. Having wasted too much time, Subaru decides to at least try to get Emilia away from Roswaal's mansion as early as possible. He then takes a dragon car back home with Rem.

episodes.title: The Outside of Madness
episodes.overview: Upon returning to Roswaal's mansion, Subaru is greeted by an unbelievable sight and wails that this was not what he wanted to happen. Stricken with despair, everything before Subaru starts to go white as, finally, he hears a voice: "You were too late."

episodes.title: The Sickness Called Despair
episodes.overview: "I just wanted to protect her. That feeling wasn't a lie. Where did I go wrong?" Rejected by the one who meant more to him than anything, Subaru is still unable to recognize that he may have done something irreversible. He then finds out that some disturbing movement has been detected within Roswaal's domain, where Emilia and the others are. He's certain that he can save them somehow, so in spite of Rem and Crusch's opposition, Subaru makes his way back to Emilia...

episodes.title: Self-Proclaimed Knight Natsuki Subaru
episodes.overview: As Emilia joins Priscilla, Crusch, and Anastasia in a meeting of the royal selection participants, Reinhard enters the hall with Felt. According to a new prophecy seen on the Dragon Stone, there are five priestesses with the potential to be the kingdom's next ruler. Reinhard announces that Felt is the fifth priestess, meaning it's time to formally begin the royal selection, but Felt refuses to have any part in it.

episodes.title: Return to the Capital
episodes.overview: At the order of the council of elders that manages Lugunica in the king's absence, Wilhelm and Felis visit Roswaal's mansion as emissaries. Emilia is required in the imperial capital right away, so Subaru asks her to take him along. Emilia tells him this won't be a pleasure trip, but a push from Rem and Roswaal ends in her agreement, so Emilia and Subaru head to the capital. Now all of the candidates to be Lugunica's next king are gathered, and the royal selection is underway.

episodes.title: Rem
episodes.overview: Knocked unconscious by Subaru's attack, Rem dreams of an event in her past that she and Ram would rather forget... a sin for which Rem feels she can never be forgiven. After waking up, she tells Subaru that she's just committed the same sin again. When the three of them are moments from being cornered by the Ulgarm pack, Subaru takes off to draw their attention so Ram and Rem can escape.

episodes.title: Fanatical Methods Like a Demon
episodes.overview: Subaru risked his life to save the children from a pack of Ulgarm, but he was so powerfully cursed that there could be no saving him. Even Beatrice is unable to undo the complex web of curses on him, and says he'll grow weak and die within half a day. The only way he can survive is if the entire Ulgarm pack is defeated, but time is not on his side. Subaru is ready to give up when he learns that Rem has gone into the forest by herself...

episodes.title: The Meaning of Courage
episodes.overview: The scattered pieces of the puzzle finally come together, and Subaru realizes for certain that the shaman who cursed him is in the village at the foot of the mountains. He heads there with Ram and Rem and makes sure all the villagers touch him so that he can find out, with Beatrice's help, who cast the curse. But the truth he finds is not what he expected, and he finds himself rushing toward the village again...

episodes.title: I Cried, Cried My Lungs Out, and Stopped Crying
episodes.overview: Subaru's first day in Roswaal's mansion begins for the fifth time. Determined to save everyone this time, he makes it a point to keep his best smile on his face in order to earn the trust of the mansion's staff. But although he works his hardest to make them like him, his body begins to have trouble keeping up with his heart's intentions. Soon Emilia is unable to bear the sight of him struggling any longer and takes an unexpected action...

episodes.title: Natsuki Subaru's Restart
episodes.overview: Standing before Subaru is someone he never expected. The truth of the attacker's identity leaves him bewildered, and he feels everything crumbling around him as he dies yet again. Then, for the fourth time, he awakes on his first day at the Roswaal mansion. This time, the night of the fourth day passes without incident, and Subaru is stunned as he greets the morning of the fifth day... but then the situation takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: The Sound of Chains
episodes.overview: Subaru's first day at the Roswaal mansion begins for the third time. The first time, he grew weak and died of unknown reasons in his sleep, and the second time, he was killed by an attacker. The sound of chains that he heard as he died the second time replays in his mind, waking him in a terrified, cold sweat. He has no idea what the killer is after, let alone who it is, so he makes a plan to leave the mansion on the fourth night and watch for the attack to happen.

episodes.title: The Morning of Our Promise Is Still Distant
episodes.overview: Subaru now lives and works in Roswaal's mansion, working with Ram and Rem, and finally getting Emilia to agree to a date with him. But the day of their promised date never comes as Subaru keeps going back to the day he first awoke in the mansion. He's confused at the thought that he Returned by Death despite having no memory of experiencing anything deadly, but he's determined to repeat his previous actions up to the point of fulfilling his promise with Emilia.

episodes.title: The Happy Roswaal Mansion Family
episodes.overview: After being badly wounded by Elsa, Subaru somehow survived and awoke in the mansion of Margrave Mathers, in the Kingdom of Lugunica.

episodes.title: Starting Life from Zero in Another World
episodes.overview: Subaru attempts to buy the insignia from Felt and return it to Satella before Elsa arrives at the loot house... but Satella arrives before the negotiations are complete, and Elsa still attacks them.

episodes.title: Reunion with the Witch
episodes.overview: After being attacked by someone the first time, sliced open by Elsa the second time, and stabbed in the back by punks the third time, Subaru should have been dead, but found himself back where he started in the same parallel world every time. He finally realizes he's acquired the power to go back to the time and place he started from, which he calls "Return by Death." In hopes of changing the fate awaiting Felt, Satella, Old Man Rom, and himself, Subaru takes off for the fourth time.

episodes.title: The End of the Beginning and the Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: Natsuki Subaru is summoned to a parallel world on his way home from the convenience store. He's entranced at first by the fantasy world suddenly stretching before his eyes, but the cute girl he believes summoned him is nowhere to be found, and soon enough he's utterly lost. Then a gang of punks surrounds him, but he quickly learns that he doesn't have any of the powers that he thought all people transported to a parallel world should have. Just when he's about to be beaten senseless, a girl appears...

title: My Hero Academia
overview: Izuku has dreamt of being a hero all his life—a lofty goal for anyone, but especially challenging for a kid with no superpowers. That’s right, in a world where eighty percent of the population has some kind of super-powered "quirk," Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal. But that’s not enough to stop him from enrolling in one of the world’s most prestigious hero academies.

episodes.title: My Hero Academia
episodes.overview: How has the world changed in the eight years since Izuku and the heroes defeated All For One and Shigaraki?

episodes.title: The Girl Who Loves Smiles
episodes.overview: The struggle against the villains may be over, but Izuku and Ochaco both still have internal demons to face.

episodes.title: Epilogue / The Hellish Todoroki Family: Final
episodes.overview: With the long conflict over at last, the time has come to rebuild. Both on a societal and personal level.

episodes.title: Izuku Midoriya: Rising
episodes.overview: After All For One takes over Shigaraki's body, the heroes must fight as one big team to defeat him.

episodes.title: From Aizawa
episodes.overview: Izuku dives deep into Shigaraki's mind, in search of the villain's origin: the tragic Tenko Shimura.

episodes.title: Wrench It Open, Izuku Midoriya!
episodes.overview: Izuku attempts to forcefully transfer One For All to Shigaraki, as this might prove to be the key to victory.

episodes.title: History's Greatest Villain
episodes.overview: The balance of power shifts between Izuku and Shigaraki when the latter steals a Quirk from One For All.

episodes.title: Quirk: Explosion!!
episodes.overview: The fierce battle with Bakugo reminds All For One of his and his brother Yoichi's origins.

episodes.title: The Final Boss
episodes.overview: Bakugo is back on his feet! Can he rescue All Might from All For One, and defeat the villain in battle?

episodes.title: The End of an Era, and the Beginning
episodes.overview: All Might receives help from an unexpected source when Stain joins him in the battle against All For One.

episodes.title: Toshinori Yagi: Rising Origin
episodes.overview: The fierce battle continues between Armored All Might and All For One. Can All Might possibly win?

episodes.title: A Chain of Events, Across the Ages
Those Who Defend, Those Who Violate
Wounded Hero, Burning Bright and True!!
The Story of How We All Became Heroes
In the Nick of Time! A Big-Time Maverick from the West!
No Man Is An Island
episodes.overview: All Might arrives at the site of his final battle in Kamino, lamenting his failure as a teacher and a hero, when he is confronted by Stain. Even after briefly revealing to him his muscle form to confirm his identity, Stain refuses to believe he is the "real All Might", and to take back his criticisms towards the hero. All Might explains his feelings on unable to make a difference due to the state of the world, only for Stain to show him a young girl who has been going out everyday to clean the All Might statue from its vandalism; the last person All Might saved during said battle. Stain tells him it wasn't power that made All Might great but his ability to inspire others and their wills to keep his flame burning, these words which start to move All Might. Stain promptly leaves, handing All Might a data disk he had retrieved from Tartarus, telling him to kill him when the time is right. At U.A., the boys give Izuku a swift soak in the bath, where Bakugo re-declares even after his apology, he still sees everyone has his rivals. After their clean-up, All Might arrives to apologize to Izuku, telling everyone they received information indicating the final battle is soon, heading back out to prepare. Izuku finally falls asleep and the rest of his classmates declare they will do everything to bring the world back. All Might meets up with Tsukauchi and the Police Force where they decode the information from Tartarus. They discover that All For One's consciousness within Shigaraki was able to communicate with his real self through Radio Waves, with the conversation revealing that Shigaraki's body will be complete in just three days. All Might requests immediate aid from the foreign heroes, with the world governments unsure how to respond due to their own issues. Despite this, America's Number 1 Hero, Star and Stripe, heads to Japan on her own with an army of fighter jets, intending to assist her "master". Shortly afterwards, Izuku wakes up from a nightmare, greeted by his classmates, whose presence helps relieve him of his stress, intending to save the day together.

episodes.title: A Young Woman's Declaration
episodes.overview: Prior to rescuing Izuku, Nezu explained to Class 1-A the intricacies designed into the U.A. Barrier to keep it fortified from villains and to protect the civilians inside. In the present, the civilians protest Izuku's entry, believing his presence will put everyone in the school in danger. Best Jeanist tries to explain everything to get them to understand, but his words only make the crowd even more anxious over the Heroes' failures, stressing Izuku out. Ochaco then grabs the megaphone and floats on top of U.A., giving a speech pleading to the civilians to let Izuku rest because Heroes deserved to be saved too. As a result, the civilians start to see how battered and tired Izuku is, and by the end of her speech, Izuku breaks down on his knees in tears. He is comforted by Kota and the mutant woman he saved earlier. One of the civilians speaks out to the rest of the crowd, admitting how much like bystanders they have been in their treatment towards the Heroes and that they should be doing their part to help in some way. After Izuku declares he will bring the world back to the way it was, the civilians accept him as he is escorted inside. Meanwhile, Nezu speaks to a recovering Aizawa in the Central Hospital, revealing that they had transferred Kurogiri to the location after the discovery of him being Shirakumo's Nomu, attempting to re-awaken him. Outside U.A., All Might leaves to find more civilians, thinking about his influence Izuku's current state, all the while Stain continues to follow him.

episodes.title: Deku vs. Class A
episodes.overview: Deku attempts to escape from his classmates, so they all try to restrain him. During their struggles, each Class 1-A student reminds Deku of something he had done for or said to them in the past, and how much their friendship means to them, but Deku refuses to listen, not wanting them to be caught up in his battle against All For One and get hurt, as his way of "protecting" them. After almost every one of their attempts to talk or pin him down fail, Deku prepares to execute Faux 100 Percent to blast himself away for good, but Class 1-A combine all of their abilities to create a massive ramp which they use to blast Iida into the sky at blistering speeds, catching up to Deku and grabbing his hand. Iida repeats what Deku had said to him in the past when he saved him, that helping without being asked is the essence of a hero, causing Deku to start to give into his exhaustion. On the ground, he once again tries to keep his distance from everyone, but Bakugo confronts him, admitting the reason behind why he bullied him in the past. He sincerely apologizes for everything he said and done, telling him the class doesn't want to reject who he is, but support him to help save everyone. Deku finally gives in and apologizes himself before passing out. He wakes up in front of the now heavily fortified U.A., only to be met by a mob of angry civilians demanding Deku not enter, aware that he is the boy Shigaraki is after. Deku is about to leave, but is stopped by Ochaco.

episodes.title: Friend
episodes.overview: Deku and the Top Three Heroes, plus The Lurkers, confront All For One at his hideout in Haibori Woods, only to find it abandoned. A recording left by All For One taunts Deku for his failures, telling him it's "his turn", before setting the mansion to explode. The Heroes escape and reconvene to discuss their options, due to the dwindling amount of Heroes left available. Meanwhile, Deku swiftly deals with the second hitman, while All Might desperately attempts to convince him to rest. Deku believes that since he can use practically use One For All at 100% without backlash, he doesn't have to watch over him anymore, and All Might can only look on devastatingly as Deku flies away, leaving him behind. Over the next several days, Deku proceeds to tirelessly travel through the city, saving whoever he can, ignoring the Heroes and the One For All predecessors' advice to take it easy. Because of this, Deku starts taking on a more monstrous appearance, with civilians scared of him and rumours going around that he is a Nomu, yet he refuses to stop, all so that he and everyone he cares about can smile again. He begins to collapse in Kamino where he confronts another hitman, Dictator, who uses his Quirk to attack Deku using nearby civilians. Due to being too tired, Deku is unable to fight and is swarmed by the mob, until he is saved by Bakugo who knocks Dictator out. After having received Deku's letters, Class 1-A figured out that Deku and All Might were working with Endeavor, and use Nezu to summon him to the school to confirm this. They state their desire to help their classmate in his moment of need and Nezu approves of them going out onto the streets to bring him back. Class 1-A confront Deku, who refuses to give in and demands they get out of his way, preparing to fight.

episodes.title: The Lovely Lady Nagant
episodes.overview: All Might is cornered by two thugs, they are scared away by his sheer tenacity refusing to leave Deku behind. Deku swings through the city to reach Lady Nagant's location, only to be caught off guard by more bullets coming from behind him, realizing she was given an extra Quirk by All For One to lure him closer to her. With no other option, Deku unleashes Smokescreen on the ground and begins to build up energy in his legs, which the third user recognizes as him using his Quirk, Fa Jin. He warns him about using it since he has no experience, but he's successfully able to feint out Nagant in the smoke and use the energy boost to blast through a building and grab her.
