episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

episodes.title: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
episodes.overview: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine: The Gate
episodes.overview: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
episodes.overview: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
episodes.overview: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Spy
episodes.overview: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. "Bob the Brain" tackles a difficult problem.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
episodes.overview: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
episodes.overview: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
episodes.overview: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

episodes.title: Chapter One: MADMAX
episodes.overview: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
episodes.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
episodes.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Monster
episodes.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
episodes.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Body
episodes.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
episodes.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

title: Peacemaker
overview: The continuing story of Peacemaker, a vainglorious superhero/supervillain who believes in peace at any cost — no matter how many people he has to kill. After a miraculous recovery from his duel with Bloodsport, Peacemaker soon discovers that his freedom comes at a price.

episodes.title: Chapter 08: Full Nelson
episodes.overview: As Flag puts everyone around him in increasing danger, the 11th Street Kids must convince Peacemaker that he's one of them.

episodes.title: Chapter 07: Like a Keith in the Night
episodes.overview: As Flag and A.R.G.U.S. close in, the 11th Street Kids attempt to keep the ever-increasing dangers of the alternate world around them at bay.

episodes.title: Chapter 06: Ignorance Is Chris
episodes.overview: As the 11th Street Kids fight to bring their missing member home, Flag doubles down on his efforts to hold Peacemaker accountable.

episodes.title: Chapter 05: Back to the Suture
episodes.overview: After a catastrophic showdown with Flag, Peacemaker makes a shocking decision, while his friends scramble to keep the 11th Street Kids together.

episodes.title: Chapter 04: Need I Say Door
episodes.overview: As A.R.G.U.S. ramps up efforts to find the QUC, Harcourt receives a tempting offer from Flag – which comes at a steep cost to Peacemaker.

episodes.title: Chapter 03: Another Rick Up My Sleeve
episodes.overview: Economos pays for the team's bungled mission, while Peacemaker explores the depths of his relationship with Harcourt in the other dimension.

episodes.title: Chapter 02: A Man Is Only as Good as His Bird
episodes.overview: As Economos clashes with his new handler, Peacemaker must deal with the consequences of his actions in the alternate dimension.

episodes.title: Chapter 01: The Ties That Grind
episodes.overview: While Peacemaker attempts to join the Justice Gang, Harcourt struggles to find work, and Economos takes on a challenging new assignment.

episodes.title: Chapter 08: It's Cow or Never
episodes.overview: With Peacemaker and Adebayo at odds, can the team kill the cow once and for all?

episodes.title: Chapter 07: Stop Dragon My Heart Around
episodes.overview: Harcourt, Murn and Adebayo find themselves surrounded by an alien force, while Peacemaker squares off against his father.

episodes.title: Chapter 06: Murn After Reading
episodes.overview: Murn reveals his deepest secret. Auggie is set free. The botched arrest of Peacemaker sends alien Goff into an unexpected new host.

episodes.title: Chapter 05: Monkey Dory
episodes.overview: The team scouts the apparent hub for the aliens' food supply, only to come face-to-face with a full-fledged invasion.

episodes.title: Chapter 04: The Choad Less Traveled
episodes.overview: After learning that the team helped land his father in prison, Peacemaker confronts his complicated past.

episodes.title: Chapter 03: Better Goff Dead
episodes.overview: On their first official mission to assassinate suspected "butterflies," Economos and Murn bond, and Peacemaker and Harcourt reach an understanding.

episodes.title: Chapter 02: Best Friends for Never
episodes.overview: After Peacemaker's hazardous escape from a disastrous metahuman hookup, tension and mistrust build within the team.

episodes.title: Chapter 01: A Whole New Whirled
episodes.overview: After making a miraculous recovery, Peacemaker returns home -- only to discover that his freedom comes at a price.

title: Solo Leveling
overview: They say whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, but that’s not the case for the world’s weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo. After being brutally slaughtered by monsters in a high-ranking dungeon, Jinwoo came back with the System, a program only he could see, that’s leveling him up in every way. Now, he’s inspired to discover the secrets behind his powers and the dungeon that spawned them.

episodes.title: On to the Next Target
episodes.overview: After no shortage of hardship, the 4th Jeju Island raid comes to a close. But for Jinwoo, the hunt never ends.

episodes.title: Are You the King of Humans
episodes.overview: Jinwoo arrives at Jeju Island to save the S-Rank hunters, but to do that he'll have to face the Ant King.

episodes.title: It's Going to Get Even More Intense
episodes.overview: As the S-Rank hunters continue fighting, they're confronted by a new magic beast resembling a humanoid ant.

episodes.title: We Need a Hero
episodes.overview: Sparks fly as the S-Rank hunters spar in preparation for the Jeju Island raid.

episodes.title: It Was All Worth It
episodes.overview: Jinwoo tries to cure his mother with the Elixir of Life while preparations for the 4th Jeju Island Raid begin.

episodes.title: Looking Up Was Tiring Me Out
episodes.overview: Seeking the remaining ingredient for the Elixir of Life, Jinwoo continues his conquest of the Demon's Castle.

episodes.title: The 10th S-rank Hunter
episodes.overview: Jinwoo officially becomes an S-Rank hunter, allowing him to finalize his preparations for the Demon's Castle.

episodes.title: Don't Look Down on My Guys
episodes.overview: The Hunters Guild strike team is confronting the high orc shaman Kargalgan when Jinwoo crashes the fight.

episodes.title: This Is What We're Trained to Do
episodes.overview: Before attempting to finish the Demon's Castle, Jinwoo decides to earn some money to help prepare.

episodes.title: I Need to Stop Faking
episodes.overview: Jinwoo realizes that he'll need to become even stronger in order to clear the Demon's Castle and decides to have his hunter rank reassessed.

episodes.title: Still a Long Way to Go
episodes.overview: Having completed his promise to Jinho to clear 19 dungeons, Jinwoo is stronger than he was when he fought the Cerberus. In order to gather the ingredients for the Elixir of Life and save his mother, he once again enters the S-Rank Demon's Castle dungeon.

episodes.title: I Suppose You aren't Aware
episodes.overview: After being trapped inside of a red gate, Jinwoo has to contend with a bloodthirsty pack of ice elves who question his humanity.

episodes.title: You aren't E-rank, are You
episodes.overview: After a scheduled meeting with Jinah's teachers, Jinwoo is asked to talk to one of her classmates, Han Song-yi, who is working as a hunter. In an effort to show her the harsh reality of the job, Jinwoo takes her to a raid designated for new hunters of the White Tiger guild.

episodes.title: Arise
episodes.overview: Drained from endless battle, Jinwoo sees a phantom of his past self. To overcome his own past as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, he struggles to find a way to clear the job-change quest.

episodes.title: A Knight Who Defends an Empty Throne
episodes.overview: Out of the blue, a "job-change quest" pops up in Jinwoo's window. Feeling that it may help him get stronger, he enters the gate. Inside, he fights wave after wave of enemies, culminating in a knight who brings back memories of the Cartenon Temple.

episodes.title: What Is This, a Picnic?
episodes.overview: Jinwoo survives tragedy once again, but Woo Jinchul warns him that Hwang Dongsoo, an S-Rank hunter, may be after his life. Determined to grow stronger, Jinwoo teams up with Jinho to raid a succession of C-Rank dungeons, but they attract attention...

episodes.title: You've Been Hiding Your Skills
episodes.overview: At the D-Rank raid, Jinwoo is reunited with four of the Cartenon Temple survivors. Together, they explore the dungeon with Kang Taeshik and his men. After splitting up, they hear a scream, and then...

episodes.title: This Is Frustrating
episodes.overview: Jinwoo answers a Hunter's Association request to take part in the raid of a D-Rank dungeon, where he encounters a few familiar faces.

episodes.title: Let's See How Far I Can Go
episodes.overview: As Jinwoo continues his training, he completes a daily quest one day by doing more than the quest requires, and a key that leads to a certain item appears in front of him.

episodes.title: The Real Hunt Begins
episodes.overview: While the C-Rank dungeon raid by Jinwoo and the others seems to be progressing well, the moment they step into an area covered in mana stones with a sleeping dungeon boss, things take a wrong turn.

episodes.title: A Pretty Good Deal
episodes.overview: Jinwoo joins a party led by Hwang Dongsuk to meet the headcount necessary for a C-Rank dungeon. Joined by another temporary hire, Yoo Jinho, the party defeats beasts without much trouble, but Jinwoo has suspicions about the group's lack of a healer.

episodes.title: I've Gotta Get Stronger
episodes.overview: Having entered the instance dungeon located inside the subway, Jinwoo levels up time and time again by fighting waves of magic beasts. As he gradually makes his way forward, he finds a long stairway leading deeper underground.

episodes.title: It's Like a Game
episodes.overview: Jinwoo remains behind in the temple dungeon to save his few surviving party members, and with a swing from the god statue's blade, his life comes to an end—or so it seems, before he wakes up in a hospital bed.

episodes.title: If I Had One More Chance
episodes.overview: Jinwoo and his party appear to have cleared a low-level dungeon, when a hidden path to an unfamiliar temple is revealed. There they encounter a set of commandments and a group of monsters that cause them absolute despair.

episodes.title: I'm Used to It
episodes.overview: Around ten years ago, gates that connected our world to another dimension began to appear, leading to the rise of hunters who would traverse these gates to fight the magic beasts within. Sung Jinwoo, E-Rank hunter, is the weakest of them all.

title: Alice in Borderland
overview: With his two friends, a video-game-obsessed young man finds himself in a strange version of Tokyo where they must compete in dangerous games to win.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Haunted by a devastating glimpse into the future, Arisu crumples under the pressure to save everyone. Will he, Usagi and the team make it to the exit?

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Arisu follows his digital double through a simulation of future Shibuya, stopping at a heartwarming scene — and the real Usagi before him.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: With time running out and a crash imminent, Usagi's group must jump trains to survive. An explosive game of Kick the Can awaits Arisu's team.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: As Rei's plan unravels, Arisu takes a risky move to keep his team alive. On a separate stage, Usagi and Ryuji face a relentless barrage of lasers.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The first game begins at a shrine. Arisu and the other players must solve math problems on the fly before everything goes up in flames.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Back in the real world with no memories of Borderland, Arisu and Usagi encounter Ryuji, a professor with a fixation on near-death experiences.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: For their final game, they'll need to survive three rounds of croquet; but before they can get very far, the Queen asks them to sit down for some tea.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: In the middle of an overgrown Shibuya crossing, Niragi challenges Arisu and Chishiya to a game. But then, the King of Spades arrives.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Usagi will have to change the hearts and minds of the cynical players on the Queen's team. At the Supreme Court, Chishiya meets the King of Diamonds.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Aguni has one thing on his mind; to find and kill the King of Spades. He's joined by Arisu and a determined high schooler named Akane Heiya.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: There are just a handful of players left, and Chishiya's the only one without a partner. The next round may very well be the last of the game.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: With only a few minutes left in the game, the results for each team seems fixed. Arisu approaches Kyuma, and asks to shake his hand.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Now that the King of Clubs has revealed himself in his full glory, the game finally begins. Much to Arisu's surprise, things are going pretty well.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Arisu, Usagi, Kuina and Chishiya have been waiting for over an hour in Shibuya crossing for the next stage to start, but nothing seems to be happening.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Tensions inside the resort reach a boiling point. As the game clock nears zero, those who've survived the onslaught now face an uncertain future.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Once a safe haven, the Beach becomes the arena for the next stage, where an epic witch hunt turns everyone against each other in a hostile showdown.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Chishiya recruits Arisu and Usagi to help him change the status quo. An unforeseen event rocks the fragile power dynamics of the Beach.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: After Arisu and Usagi find their way to the Beach, the king of the so-called utopian haven forces them to help gather the remaining playing cards.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Arisu is overwhelmed with guilt and ready to give up, but Usagi urges him to keep going. Next up is a game of endurance in an underground highway.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: With Chota and Shibuki's visas fast expiring, the four enter a vast botanical garden in Shinjuku, where they take part in a cruel game of betrayal.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Leaving an injured Chota, Arisu and Karube head out to gain more experience. They come to a sprawling apartment, where a deadly game of tag awaits.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Arisu and his friends run into a public bathroom to hide from the police, but when they reemerge, the streets of Tokyo are suddenly completely empty.

title: Cobra Kai
overview: This Karate Kid sequel series picks up 30 years after the events of the 1984 All Valley Karate Tournament and finds Johnny Lawrence on the hunt for redemption by reopening the infamous Cobra Kai karate dojo. This reignites his old rivalry with the successful Daniel LaRusso, who has been working to maintain the balance in his life without mentor Mr. Miyagi.

episodes.title: Ex-Degenerate
episodes.overview: Fierce rivalries. Fresh opportunities. Daniel and Johnny find themselves back where it all began — and the stakes have never been higher.

episodes.title: Strike Last
episodes.overview: The action heats up as the Valley's top fighters pit their courage against their rivals' speed and strength. But one last surprise changes everything.

episodes.title: Skeletons
episodes.overview: As the moment of truth arrives, Daniel and Johnny confront their pasts. Then it's fight time as Robby battles Axel in the world karate championship.

episodes.title: Rattled
episodes.overview: Sam and Robby turn to their friends for support as they train for the challenges ahead. Johnny and Carmen welcome a new addition to the team.

episodes.title: Into the Fire
episodes.overview: While their students plan for life after karate, Daniel and Johnny clash over reviving the Sekai Taikai. Kreese reconsiders his guiding principles.

episodes.title: Eunjangdo
episodes.overview: Daniel and Johnny use historic Barcelona as a training ground for their captains. But a cheap shot in the semifinals sparks a brawl to end all brawls.

episodes.title: Blood in Blood Out
episodes.overview: Who will move to the next round in the tournament's tag team elimination match: Miyagi-Do or Cobra Kai? A shocking revelation shatters Daniel's world.

episodes.title: Snakes on a Plane
episodes.overview: A personal crisis shakes Miguel and Johnny to the core. Chozen and a rival sensei team up to find their students — but discover something else instead.

episodes.title: Dog in the Fight
episodes.overview: The search for clues about Mr. Miyagi's past leads Daniel into danger. Miguel raises doubts about Robby's focus. Sam observes ugly behavior off the mat.

episodes.title: Benvinguts a Barcelona
episodes.overview: With the Sekai Taikai underway, a betrayal threatens to throw team Miyagi-Do off their game. A dramatic first event unleashes the element of surprise.

episodes.title: Best of the Best
episodes.overview: Miyagi-Do's top students square off to be team captains, but a devastating tragedy changes everything. Kreese reveals his final surprise.

episodes.title: Underdogs
episodes.overview: Daniel and Johnny invite a new sensei to evaluate their students. Friends become foes as the competition heats up for a spot in the Sekai Taikai.

episodes.title: Sleeper
episodes.overview: A shocking discovery turns Daniel's world upside down. Johnny schemes a way to give Sam and Tory their edge back. The tournament reveals its location.

episodes.title: The Prize
episodes.overview: Kreese faces a dangerous test to prove his worthiness. Daniel offers Johnny a helping hand while the teens contemplate life beyond high school.

episodes.title: Peacetime in the Valley
episodes.overview: The Miyagi-Do students struggle to put aside past rivalries while training for the Sekai Taikai. Johnny and Chozen clash over rebranding the dojo.

episodes.title: Head of the Snake
episodes.overview: A fight night erupts in the Valley as Johnny, Daniel, Chozen and their students summon all their skills and strength to expose Terry and take him down.

episodes.title: Survivors
episodes.overview: Tory pays a price for defiance. Stingray does battle with his conscience. A celebratory night on the town takes a turn for Johnny, Daniel and Chozen.

episodes.title: Taikai
episodes.overview: A coveted spot in an elite international tournament ignites a fight between dojos. Tory's loyalties are tested. Sam struggles to let Miguel go.

episodes.title: Bad Eggs
episodes.overview: Terry and Kim issue a brutal challenge while Chozen teaches his students a different kind of lesson. Johnny and Daniel demand answers from Kreese.

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.overview: Terry recruits an expert in the way of the fist. Daniel walks away from a fight, and Johnny and Chozen pick one. In prison, Kreese confronts old demons.

episodes.title: Extreme Measures
episodes.overview: Daniel leans on a friend – and frenemy. Tensions come to a head for Miguel and Robby. A familiar face returns.

episodes.title: Downward Spiral
episodes.overview: Johnny and Carmen's romance flies high while Daniel and Amanda are rattled by Terry's schemes. The teens' feuds spill over at the waterpark.

episodes.title: Playing With Fire
episodes.overview: Another enemy from Daniel's past resurfaces. After a spa day and some soul-searching, Sam comes to a decision about her future with Miguel.

episodes.title: Molé
episodes.overview: Chozen and Daniel hatch a risky plot against Terry. In Mexico, Robby and Johnny look for Miguel, who discovers the truth about his dad.

episodes.title: Long, Long Way From Home
episodes.overview: Daniel's new ally-turned-housemate tests Amanda's patience. Miguel searches for his father in Mexico. Terry starts to transform Cobra Kai.

episodes.title: The Rise
episodes.overview: The tournament comes to a shocking end, with the aftermath leaving its participants reeling – and two champions facing uncertain futures.

episodes.title: The Fall
episodes.overview: The annual All Valley Karate Tournament kicks off as several competing dojos vie for the grand championship – and settle some personal scores.

episodes.title: Party Time
episodes.overview: Miguel and Sam are excited about attending the junior prom until another couple unexpectedly shows up. Terry lures Johnny to a familiar location.

episodes.title: Minefields
episodes.overview: Daniel invites Anthony to join Miyagi-Do and discovers he doesn't know his son as well as he thought. Miguel learns the truth about Johnny and Carmen.

episodes.title: Kicks Get Chicks
episodes.overview: A major change to the upcoming tournament sends Johnny scrambling to find a new recruit for Eagle Fang. Tory must ask a favor of the LaRussos.

episodes.title: Match Point
episodes.overview: Johnny and Daniel's dojo — and their fragile alliance — teeter on the brink of collapse when they agree to a winner-takes-all sensei showdown.

episodes.title: Bicephaly
episodes.overview: Kreese brings Terry back to Cobra Kai, but his former partner isn't interested in repeating history. Johnny grows envious of Daniel mentoring Miguel.

episodes.title: Then Learn Fly
episodes.overview: Kenny tries to become a student of Cobra Kai with some encouragement from Robby, while Johnny urges Sam to take a leap of faith - in herself.

episodes.title: First Learn Stand
episodes.overview: Johhny picks up defensive strategies while Daniel learns hot to go on the offensive. Amanda confronts Tory. New kid Kenny is bullied at school.

episodes.title: Let's Begin
episodes.overview: Johnny and Daniel combine dojos but their opposing styles immediately clash. Kreese tries to persuade a former partner to rejoin him at Cobra Kai.

episodes.title: December 19
episodes.overview: Old wounds begin to heal at a country club holiday party, but a brutal assault by Kreese's students leads to new betrayals and alliances.

episodes.title: Feel The Night
episodes.overview: It's Christmastime in the Valley, and romance is in the air. Daniel and Miguel find unexpected common ground, and the Cobra Kai recruits go on a mission.

episodes.title: The Good, The Bad, and The Badass
episodes.overview: Informed that this year's All Valley Karate Tournament is being canceled, the three competing sensei attend a city council meeting to save it.

episodes.title: Obstáculos
episodes.overview: Daniel spends some father-daughter time with a traumatized Sam. Johnny plans to form a new karate dojo but struggles to come up with a cool name.

episodes.title: King Cobra
episodes.overview: Miguel helps Johnny craft the perfect social media message. Kreese scouts new recruits while Daniel and Amanda try to shut down Cobra Kai.

episodes.title: Miyagi-Do
episodes.overview: In Okinawa, Daniel spends time with an old friend — and an old enemy, who has much to teach him. The dueling dojos' rivalry comes to a nasty head.

episodes.title: The Right Path
episodes.overview: Following an important meeting in Japan, Daniel revisits Mr. Miyagi's hometown on Okinawa. Johnny attempts to reconnect with Robby.

episodes.title: Now You're Gonna Pay
episodes.overview: Daniel's tarnished public image takes a toll on his sales, leading to a takeover offer. Johnny tries to raise money for Miguel's surgery.

episodes.title: Nature Vs. Nurture
episodes.overview: Daniel and Johnny team up to find Robby. Miguel faces an uncertain future. Kreese tries to bring Tory back to Cobra Kai.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.overview: Miguel's fighting for his life, Robby's missing, and Daniel and Johnny's reputations are in tatters as the community reacts to the West Valley brawl.

episodes.title: No Mercy
episodes.overview: The two warring faction students meet head-on at West Valley High School on the first day of school, with both sides looking for revenge.

episodes.title: Pulpo
episodes.overview: Johnny goes out on a date with Carmen, and they end up at the same restaurant as Daniel and Amanda. Moon tries to bring the two warring dojos together at a party before school starts, but things don't go as plan.

episodes.title: Glory of Love
episodes.overview: When Carmen gets a new boyfriend, Johnny turns to a dating app to meet women. Daniel turns to his mother Lucille for advice when Amanda refuses his attempts to apologize for neglecting her and the business.

episodes.title: Lull
episodes.overview: Kreese persuades Johnny to take the Cobra Kai students out for the Coyote Creek challenge. Daniel has trouble balancing his new training responsibilities with his wife and job.

episodes.title: Take a Right
episodes.overview: Daniel makes a revelation about his past to his students old and new. Johnny goes on a road trip with three old friends, and Kreese teaches the Cobra Kai students his own philosophy.

episodes.title: All In
episodes.overview: Johnny advises his students to go all in when attacking, and tries to apply that philosophy to his relationship with Robby. Meanwhile, Demetri has trouble fitting in with Miyagi-do, and Hawk comes after him, while Tory convinces Miguel to come with her on a date.

episodes.title: The Moment of Truth
episodes.overview: Miguel notices the discrepancies in Kreese's stories and goes to Johnny with his suspicions. Daniel wonders how to bring students to Miyagi-do, and Aisha makes a new friend.

episodes.title: Fire and Ice
episodes.overview: Johnny manages to get onto the Internet and sees Daniel's ad for his new dojo. The two dojos choose the local ValleyFest to demonstrate their skills and one-up each other.

episodes.title: Back in Black
episodes.overview: Daniel and Johnny both find their own paths to training their students, with Kreese observing Johnny's methods.

episodes.title: Mercy, Part II
episodes.overview: After Miguel wins the championship, an old friend stops by Cobra Kai to congratulate Johnny. Daniel and Robby prepare Miyagi-Do and get a second student.

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.overview: Cobra Kai fights in the All Valley Karate Championship, and the final match comes down to Miguel and Robby. Each of them put their sensei's lessons to use but only one can emerge the victor. Afterward, Johnny receives a visit from a figure from his past.

episodes.title: Different But Same
episodes.overview: Amanda forces Daniel to give Johnny a new car to replace the one Louie burned up, and Johnny and Daniel bond over their common upbringings. Meanwhile, Miguel suspects that Samantha is cheating on him with Robby, and Daniel finds out that Robby is Johnny's son.

episodes.title: Molting
episodes.overview: While training with Daniel, Robby gets closer to Samantha and Miguel notices. Meanwhile, Johnny tries to make amends for his past.

episodes.title: All Valley
episodes.overview: Johnny and Miguel give each other advice, on getting the ban lifted on Cobra Kai from the All-Valley Tournament and dating Samantha. However, Daniel has something to say about Johnny's attempts to get Cobra Kai in.

episodes.title: Quiver
episodes.overview: Robby puts up with hazing by Louie, and Daniel takes pity on him. Meanwhile, Johnny discovers that students have changed in the last 30 years and remembers his own childhood.

episodes.title: Counterbalance
episodes.overview: Daniel schemes to raise the rent on Johnny's dojo, forcing him to leave. Meanwhile, Miguel puts Johnny's training to use, and Robby gets a job after seeing his father with Miguel.

episodes.title: Cobra Kai Never Dies
episodes.overview: Someone defaces Daniel's dealership billboard, and he suspects his rival. Meanwhile, Samantha learns the truth about Kyler, and Johnny has eye-awakening meetings with his son and ex-wife.

episodes.title: Esqueleto
episodes.overview: Johnny starts Miguel's training in earnest while beginning an online promotion of his dojo. Meanwhile, Daniel volunteers to chaperone the school Halloween dance to keep an eye on Samantha but comes face-to-face with a skeleton from his past.

episodes.title: Strike First
episodes.overview: Daniel finds out about Johnny's new dojo and realizes that he's lost the balance that he had in the past. Meanwhile, Johnny deals with his own errant son while training Miguel.

episodes.title: Ace Degenerate
episodes.overview: In 2018, Johnny Lawrence lives in dreams of the past and how his life was great until Daniel LaRusso beat him in a karate tournament. Now Daniel owns a successful auto group and Johnny gets by on menial jobs. But things change when Johnny sees a teenage boy beat up on by bullies.

title: Scissor Seven
overview: Seeking to recover his memory, a scissor-wielding, hairdressing, bungling quasi-assassin stumbles into a struggle for power among feuding factions.

episodes.title: Battle of Black Rock Mountain
episodes.overview: Seemingly Thirteen goes to Black Rock Mountain to rescue Green Phoenix. But something unexpected happens.

episodes.title: Eyeless Master's Prophecy
episodes.overview: After escaping the Villa, Seven finds a graveyard with a familiar girl's grave. The Eyeless Sorcerer tells him a story about an assassin and Xuanwu.

episodes.title: Prison Break
episodes.overview: Seven, Dai Bo, and DaChun get locked inside the Villa. Unfinished business between Seven and the butler resurfaces. Meanwhile, a new threat emerges in the background.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: Thirteen arrives at the Villa to duel her father, but she still has a lot to learn. The most important to master is controlling her Qi.

episodes.title: Bravely Barging Into Plum Blossom Mountain Villa
episodes.overview: Seven arrives at the Plum Blossom Villa, he finds DaChun and Eleven tied up with the butler. They tell him how they got here.

episodes.title: Nine-Fingered Deadful Melody
episodes.overview: After being forced to walk, Seven and Dai Bo go into a bar to search for Thirteen. They also meet Meow Cai's master, Nine-Fingered Dreadful Melody.

episodes.title: Thumbs-Up Showdown
episodes.overview: Seven starts his journey to the Plum Blossom Villa along with Dai Bo and Xiao Fei, they run into Ouyang Zan, but he challenges Seven to a duel to avenge his master.

episodes.title: Acting Chairman of Chicken Island
episodes.overview: After his battle with White Fox, Redtooth starts working as the new chairman on Chicken Island.

episodes.title: Return to Xuanwu
episodes.overview: Turns out, Seven getting his memories back could have unforeseeable consequences. Cheap Life Hua tries teaching Seven how to control his powers.

episodes.title: Seven's Special Mission
episodes.overview: Seven and Cheap Life Hua expel the poisons from Seven's body, but he starts wondering if he has made the right decision.

episodes.title: Green Phoenix's Revenge
episodes.overview: Green Phoenix confronts his own fears in an effort to challenge a formidable foe. But with Thirteen held captive, he has a tough choice to make.

episodes.title: Showdown on the Chicken Island
episodes.overview: Upon arriving at Chicken Island, Prince of Stan and Cola struggle to defeat the powerful White Fox — but unexpected help is on the way.

episodes.title: The Decision
episodes.overview: While the cats and dogs of Chicken Island prepare for an attack against White Fox, Seven finds himself battling three different poisons in his body.

episodes.title: Redtooth's Past
episodes.overview: Decades after the tragic downfall of the Heaven Lily Sect, Chairman Jiang must confront her former lover, who's been possessed by a demon.

episodes.title: Huilian's past
episodes.overview: In order to save a loved one, Chairman Jiang embarks on a journey to the Heaven Lily Sect, where she and Quan crossed paths a long time ago.

episodes.title: Crisis on the Island 2
episodes.overview: With the arrival of White Fox, a new threat suddenly looms over Chicken Island. As Seven regains consciousness, he receives an intimidating phone call.

episodes.title: Overnight at the Store
episodes.overview: In a convenience store on Chicken Island, Seven's friend Ordinary Assassin confronts an armed robber. But things do not go as planned.

episodes.title: Saving Seven
episodes.overview: Dai Bo overcomes a series of hurdles to locate Seven, who is now a target of multiple powerful Shadow assassins.

episodes.title: Assassinating the Leader
episodes.overview: Green Phoenix arrives at the Shadow assassins' headquarters, where he seizes an opportunity to execute a long-awaited plan of revenge.

episodes.title: The "Immortal" Black Bird
episodes.overview: To rescue Thirteen, Seven confronts Blackbird in a heated battle as a secret history of the Flying Bird Sect resurfaces.

episodes.title: Who Is the One You Want to Protect
episodes.overview: Shadow assassin Manjusaka confronts Seven. In a true test of her powers, Thirteen engages in a heated clash with Blackbird.

episodes.title: Memories That You Don't Want to Forget Even in Pain
episodes.overview: Seven fends off Xuanwu assassins while under the influence of the blade's powers, as memories of life on Chicken Island begin to fade.

episodes.title: Master Green Phoenix's Scheme
episodes.overview: In Xuanwu, Seven faces the powerful Eyeless Sorcerer and undergoes a transformation. Thirteen struggles to choose a side.

episodes.title: Sneaking Into Xuanwu Country
episodes.overview: As Cola's life hangs by a thread, Seven sneaks into Xuanwu with Da Bao and Xiao Fei to find the medicine to cure her.

episodes.title: Superpower Country
episodes.overview: In Superpower Country, Seven encounters Pingan, a boy with mind control powers. A searing battle with the Prince of Stern erupts.

episodes.title: Rock Hard Country
episodes.overview: Seven arrives at He Dachun's hometown, where he must win a pentathlon against the muscular Coach Chen to save Xiao Fei from being eaten.

episodes.title: Tenderness of a Tough Man
episodes.overview: Plum Blossom Eleven talks He Dachun into escorting her to Xuanwu, but Flying Bird Gate members capture her, demanding their martial arts script back.

episodes.title: Excuse Me, Is This the Xuanwu Country?
episodes.overview: Seven makes a stopover in Dali Nation, known for its beautiful people — but an overlord with dark mirror magic has turned everyone hideous.

episodes.title: Dai Bo & Seven
episodes.overview: Da Bao sets out with Xiao Fei in search of Seven and recalls how Seven once bent over backwards to help him find an antidote.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.overview: After word spreads about Seven's triumph over the Blood Demon, Seven realizes he must leave the island in order to keep its residents safe.

episodes.title: Fate
episodes.overview: Seven reconnects with his old self, but to defeat the Blood Demon, he must harness the power of Xuanwu martial arts — and the barber within.

episodes.title: Redtooth
episodes.overview: Redtooth arrives on the Island to confront Chairman Jiang, who activates the powerful White Lily Blossom with Seven's help.

episodes.title: Two Heroes
episodes.overview: Years ago Qing Feng went on a killing spree in order to be recruited in the killer league. Two years later a unknown youth joined the organisation. Qing Feng took an interest in him.

episodes.title: Plum Blossom Eleven
episodes.overview: Thirteen accepts Seven's date on the beach but she isn't who she appears to be. Enters Eleven, a deceitful assassin and Thirteen's sister.

episodes.title: Revenge of King Pheasant
episodes.overview: And old foe comes back from the past to haunt Dai Bo. He must defeat Kinf Pheasant to save Xiao Fei and Seven's lives!

episodes.title: Again, We Meet Captain Jack
episodes.overview: Captain Jack comes back on Chicken Island to settle an old grudge with Seven.

episodes.title: The Stan Trip
episodes.overview: Cola is hanging out with Seven but loses sight of him after she races him from the top of a hill. She finds the Prince of Stan, who was looking for the machine he left on the island at the end of season 1, and convinces him to let her visit Stan.

episodes.title: Protecting Mad Bark
episodes.overview: A strange musician dog comes to Chicken Island and defies Mad Bark. He uses a mysterious music to pierce his opponent's heart. But why is he set on killing Mad Bark?

episodes.title: Thirteen vs. Seven
episodes.overview: Thirteen comes back to kill Seven as her master ordered. She reveals Xuanwu's nefarious plan to invade Chicken Island.

episodes.title: Super Scissors
episodes.overview: Word spread of Stan's defeat by Seven. Assassins come from all over the world to defeat the strong killer who beat the Prince of Stan.

episodes.title: King of Chicken 3
episodes.overview: Determined to teach humans a lesson, Da Bao gives King Pheasant a taste of his own medicine and liberates the chickens from their coops.

episodes.title: King of Chicken 2
episodes.overview: Seeking to avenge his friend, Da Bao throws his hat in the ring for a fight against King Pheasant, but in his current state he's going to need a boost.

episodes.title: King of Chicken 1
episodes.overview: Da Bao reflects on Da Fei, who once faced King Pheasant in a fight so that his son Xiao Fei could become a fighter chicken instead of a dinner chicken.

episodes.title: Thirteen
episodes.overview: Thirteen's past comes to light: as the Plum Blossom Swordsman's estranged daughter, she joined the world of killers after a tragic incident.

episodes.title: Thousand Demon Daggers
episodes.overview: Thirteen comes to Seven's aid in a heated clash with the Prince of Stan. Seven recalls his past as a prominent figure in Xuanwu.

episodes.title: Crisis on the Island
episodes.overview: Seven teams up with islanders to stop the Prince of Stan from extracting an energy rock and destroying the island, but Stan's technology is too robust.

episodes.title: Bodyguard Dachun
episodes.overview: Hired by a woman to assassinate her husband, Seven confronts — and bonds with — impervious bodyguard He Dachun, who makes a heartrending sacrifice.

episodes.title: Assassinating Captain Jack
episodes.overview: On behalf of the underfunded coast guard, Seven agrees to kill the captain of a submarine that's threatening the island.

episodes.title: Assassinating a Pretty Girl
episodes.overview: Cola, Seven's next target, enlists his help in checking off a bucket list of mischievous deeds, but the client who hired Seven has a secret.

episodes.title: Assassinating a Domineering Grannie
episodes.overview: Seven shape-shifts into a cardboard box and contends with a stabby, swindling fruit vendor whose grandson got a bad haircut from Seven's shears.

episodes.title: Assassinating Underpantsman
episodes.overview: The Island Purity Society summons Seven to kill an underwear collector, but Seven encourages everyone to embrace their differences.

episodes.title: Seven vs. Thirteen
episodes.overview: It's scissors versus sword as Seven faces off against Thirteen. He's no match for his deft opponent — so he transforms into half a durian.

episodes.title: Blind Your Eyes
episodes.overview: Meow, the Chief of Cats, hires Seven to wipe out an old flame. But after hearing a star-crossed interspecies love story, he attempts to make peace.

episodes.title: How to Get Rich
episodes.overview: Cash-strapped Seven flunks a crash course in professional killing and opens a hair salon as a cover. First assignment: cut off a bride's hair.

title: Alien: Earth
overview: When the mysterious deep space research vessel USCSS Maginot crash-lands on Earth, Wendy and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

episodes.title: The Real Monsters
episodes.overview: A new power dynamic emerges.

episodes.title: Emergence
episodes.overview: An escape plan is hatched leading to a breaking of factions, betrayals, and a shocking confrontation.

title: Fate/strange Fake
overview: In a Holy Grail War, Mages (Masters) and their Heroic Spirits (Servants) fight for the control of the Holy Grail—an omnipotent wish-granting device said to fulfill any desire. Years have passed since the end of the Fifth Holy Grail War in Japan. Now, signs portend the emergence of a new Holy Grail in the western American city of Snowfield. Sure enough, Masters and Servants begin to gather... A missing Servant class... Impossible Servant summonings... A nation shrouded in secrecy... And a city created as a battleground. In the face of such irregularities, the Holy Grail War is twisted and driven into the depth of madness. Let the curtain rise on a masquerade of humans and heroes, made to dance upon the stage of a false Holy Grail.

episodes.title: This Illusion Becomes Reality
episodes.overview: Francesca and the others descend into a dream realm filled with chaos.

episodes.title: At the End of the Rope
episodes.overview: Cerberus stands before Saber and Ayaka inside the dreamworld. Though the police were fighting alongside them, the wounds Saber bore from his previous battle has put him in a critical situation. In an attempt to shake off the weakness that dwells within her, Ayaka hurries to be by his side. But before she can reach him, the shadow of "Little Red" appears before her. Faced with the terrifying specter of her past, the symbol of her deepest fears, she says...

episodes.title: The Pale Knight
episodes.overview: Though Archer had defeated Saber, the King of Heroes was also forced to fall when his treasury was sealed off by Philia's intervention. However, before the shifting tides of the battle could be seen through, a massive fog suddenly enveloped the city. The police force, Flat, Hansa, and members of each faction were all helplessly swallowed by the black fog. When Sigma awoke, he found himself in a garden where the girl at the center of the conflict, Tsubaki Kuruoka, was playing with animals.

episodes.title: Gold and Lion
episodes.overview: True Archer, having defeated Berserker, stands before the police force menacingly, as if embodying despair itself. Meanwhile, Saber, facing off against Archer, races across the battlefield, using his speed and rapid-fire Noble Phantasm to fend off the King of Heroes. Hansa, witnessing Saber's seemingly relentless barrage of Noble Phantasms, looks over to Ayaka, who is supplying the magical energy that fuels them, and asks her a question.

episodes.title: The Nightmare Comes With the Dawn of London
episodes.overview: Clan Calatin has arrived in front of the entrance of the hospital in hopes of executing a rescue mission for Tsubaki. However, before them appears Alcides, along with his giant dog. The police force and Berserker confront Alcides, who is intent on slaying Tsubaki after identifying her as an enemy in this Holy Grail War, and one by one Servants begin to gather, as if drawn in by the chaos. And thus, the Holy Grail War in Snowfield plunges into a vortex of mayhem.

episodes.title: Backstage of a Third-rate Comedy
episodes.overview: To repair their damaged Noble Phantasms, several members of Clan Calatin are sent to Caster's magecraft workshop. After the police officer John Wingard lost his right arm in the previous battle, Caster questions whether he is still determined to take part in the Holy Grail War. Meanwhile, Flat and Berserker attempt to infiltrate the police station after sensing an ominous magical energy enveloping the city.

episodes.title: Back from Twilight, the God Is Come
episodes.overview: Prior to the battle between Saber and Lancer, Halri Vorzak, a girl who harbors deep hatred for the world of magecraft, summons a Servant of her own. However, what answers her call is an utterly uncontrollable and aberrant Heroic Spirit. As its claws tear through her abdomen, her life begins to trickle away until a lone homunculus reaches out to grasp her dying hand.

episodes.title: The Wandering King's Rock 'n' Roll
episodes.overview: After leaving the detention center, Saber and Ayaka wander through Snowfield in search of allies. Before long, the two entered a forest made home by Lancer, the Servant who recently engaged in a spectacular battle against Archer. Challenged to prove his prowess and determine whether they would make suitable allies, Saber unleashes his Noble Phantasm as Lionheart.

episodes.title: Stars' Banquet
episodes.overview: Shortly before the battle in the canyon, in a mansion situated in a swamp, a lone mercenary attempted to summon a Servant. His codename is Sigma. He holds no desires for this world, nor any intention of leaving anything behind. Chosen by the fake Holy Grail for this empty shell of a man was a Servant so singularly unique that it could never be summoned in a normal Holy Grail War...

episodes.title: The Canon of Demigods
episodes.overview: The sun has risen, closing the curtains on the night of the battle at the police station. Orlando, busy with caring for the aftermath of the battle, is visited by Francesca. He fails to conceal his frustration towards Francesca's flippant attitude. Suddenly, a single arrow soars past them, aimed at Gilgamesh and Tiné who are positioned at the Crystal Hill. After intercepting the second arrow fired shortly thereafter, Gilgamesh and Tiné proceed toward the canyon where they discover another Archer waiting for them.

episodes.title: A Battle without Heroes
episodes.overview: Clan Calatin finds itself in dire straits after interference from Assassin's Master, Jester Karture. Hansa intervenes, taking up arms not as the Overseer of the Holy Grail War, but as an Executor hunting Dead Apostles. With the Servants dismissed from the stage, the two men clash in a battle fought without Heroic Spirits.

episodes.title: Ensemble VS Pretense
episodes.overview: Following the uproar at the opera house, Saber and Ayaka are detained by the Snowfield Police Department. Saber answers the police's questioning candidly, showing no regard for maintaining the secrecy of the Holy Grail War. As Orlando expresses exasperation in dealing with Saber and the fallout he is causing, Orlando is visited by a certain man—Hansa Cervantes, a priest dispatched by the Holy Church as Overseer in this fake Holy Grail War.

episodes.title: The Heroic Spirit Incident
episodes.overview: Due to the anomalous battle taking place in the desert between Archer and Lancer, various factions become aware of the commencement of the Holy Grail War. Faldeus, tirelessly acquiring information and manipulating the press, catches sight of a girl new to Snowfield. This girl is Ayaka Sajyou, who wanders the city aimlessly. A mark resembling a Command Spell is engraved on her body.
